content.text: The model concept and mathematical modelling -- Teacher acting in modeling processes Study environment: Modelling Days -- Methodology and method based on qualitative content analysis -- Heuristic strategies for self-employment-enhancing teacher interventions. Peter Stender examines how teachers should act to support pupils in the most independent approach to a complex modeling issue, while ensuring that a meaningful response to the modelling problem is created. He examines this question within the framework of three-day modelling days Mathematics by evaluating videographs using qualitative content analysis. He identifies effective teacher interventions and develops on this basis theory-guided further teacher interventions using heuristic strategies. The content The model concept and mathematical modelling Teacher trading in modeling processes Study environment: Modelling Days Methodology and method based on qualitative content analysis Heuristic strategies for self-employment-enhancing teacher interventions The target groups of mathematics didactics and students of mathematics teachers and their education and training groups The University of Hamburg is a professor of mathematics at the University of Hamburg.
content.title_en: Effective teacher intervention in complex modelling tasks

content.text: The significance of employee-related measures for motivation of participation: An empirical study from the point of view of managers and employees. Employee-related surveys are an integral part of change management. Hannes Traut notes that studies that consider their effectiveness are scarcely sown. Investigations on the influence of specific characteristics of the follow-up process on the effectiveness of employee-related surveys are also rare. The author's starting point is therefore the systematic consideration of the holistic process. In this context, he examines specifically how the action-related measures affect the motivation of employees. The content Theoretical principles: employee surveys, motivation and behaviour, evaluation and evaluation research, action research as a research method in the context of organizations Matching the results of the various data collection methods Reflection of action research in the context of the conducted study Criteria for the evaluation of employee-related measures The target groups Dozierende and students of the fields of organizational psychology and economics Practically active in the field of human resource and change management Hannes Traut is currently working as a personnel-related survey of the employee-related activities in the field of employee-related research.
content.title_en: The importance of accompanying measures in employee surveys for motivation to participate : An empirical study from the point of view of managers and employees

content.text: Optimum concept design of electrified vehicle drivetrains: A computer-based methodology for accelerating the design process. Basics of electrified drivetrains -- Operational strategy -- Determination of design criteria and boundary conditions -- Optimization of the drivetrain. Frederik Weiß develops a simulation-based methodology for identifying optimal BEV, PHEV and FCEV drivetrain configurations. Through its extensive analysis of all major influences on the overall drivetrain system, the author can accelerate the early concept phase of the vehicle development process and simultaneously improve its result quality. Simulation is carried out using computational-time efficient models and calculation methods specially created for this application case as well as a multi-criteria optimization algorithm. The strengths of the methodology are the high variability, modularization and consideration of special characteristics of electrified drives, such as the influence of voltage situations and the derating behaviour of individual components.
content.title_en: Optimal design of the concept of electrified vehicle drivetrains: A computer-aided methodology to accelerate the design process

content.text: The methodology for assessing property-optimized bodywork concepts in mixed construction. Planning the methodology -- Collection, analysis and structuring of knowledge -- Development and validation of methodology -- Implementation of methodology. Jan Hasenpusch describes a methodology for holistic assessment of the impact of parameter variations on the properties and characteristics of a product using the example of bodywork concepts. The development is carried out systematically taking into account Model Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) and Knowledge Based Engineering (KBE) to master the complexity and to exploit the advantages of both strategies. The basis is an extension of the Characteristics Properties Modelling. This results in a methodology consisting of the process steps Synthesis, Analysis and Evaluation. These are carried out in a MBSE comprehensive system consisting of knowledge-based subsystems. Bodywork concepts are generated, analysed and assessed holistically from required properties. The content Planning the methodology Collection, Analysis and structuring of knowledge Development and validation of methodology Implementation of methodology The target groups Dozierende und Studieren in der Fachbereiche Konstruktionsmetosmittelnung, Simulation und Konzionsauslegung Ingenieureinnen und Ingenierenden Ingenieurein der Automobilierung (Findustriemen) in der Ingendition.
content.title_en: Methodology for assessing properties-optimised bodywork concepts in mixed construction

content.text: A driver assistance system to increase the range of electric vehicles. Gernot Becker shows that automated vehicle longitudinal guidance has the potential to increase the range of an electric vehicle. In his study, the author creates the necessary energy optimisations using predictive information and model predictive calculations. In quantifying using test carriers in customer-relevant driving operations, the author determines a significant reduction in the energy demand of energy-efficient, automated vehicle longitudinal guidance. Such a driver assistance system is thus an effective approach to address the range problem of today's battery-electric vehicles.The content Range problem of battery-electric vehicles Methodically identifying a system concept Elements of energy-efficient, automated vehicle longitudinal guidance Concept for quantifying the effect on the range The target groups lecturers and students of vehicle technology with the focus on electromobility Scientists, research and development engineers, executives in the automotive industry and at research facilities in the field of electromobility The author Gernot Becker is currently active in research and advance development in the automotive industry.
content.title_en: A driver assistance system to increase the range of electric vehicles

content.text: Thermomanagement of high-performance vehicle traction batteries based on coupled simulation models. Hannes Hopp explains the need for cooling lithium-ion batteries in the vehicle and presents a simulative method for predicting battery temperatures and interaction with the cooling system in the vehicle network. In the simulation network, the battery model forms the central component. Based on existing modelling approaches, the author examines the waste heat characteristics of the battery from single cell measurements and transfers them into a modular simulation model. The results of his study underline the need for close interlocking of simulative and experimental tools in vehicle development. The coupled simulation represents a target-oriented method for evaluating thermal and electrical interaction in an electrified vehicle. The content of state of the art and basics of lithium-ion batteries Simulation models – structure and function Experimental investigations and validation Thermal system behaviour under range aspects and in circuit operation The target groups Dozierende and students of automotive technology, especially the vehicle drives Practitioners in the automotive industry, especially in the development of thermo-ion batteries and battery systems The research unit of the University of Stuttgart is currently working as a research unit for the field of thermo-function and battery systems.
content.title_en: Thermomanagement of high-performance vehicle traction batteries based on coupled simulation models

content.text: The Business Administration, Sustainable Development and the Energy Transition: The Roles of Financial Intermediaries in Transition Processes of the Energy Economy in Germany and Poland. Sustainability transitions -- Financing of Renewable Energies -- Financial Systems, Energy Economy and Policy in Germany and Poland -- Contribution of Institutional and Strategic Investors, Banks, Regional Actors to the Energy Transition . In this book Johanna Dichtl examines the contribution of the financial economy to the energy transition, in which it is generally attributed a key role, as well as energy supply, to all sub-sectors of the economy and society. However, the financial economy is considered by some as part of the problem and by others as part of the solution – an ambivalence that illuminates this work against the background of the financing of renewable energy projects and infrastructure investments.
content.title_en: Financial Economy, Sustainable Development and the Energy Transition: The Role of Financial Intermediaries in Transition Processes of the Energy Economy in Germany and Poland

content.text: In the context of the research areas Criticality Analysis, Life Cycle Impact Assessment and Social Life Cycle Assessment, Christoph Kolotzek develops a model for the evaluation of metallic raw materials and presents a guide to the integration of the model in the entrepreneurial context. When purchasing or selecting individual raw materials or raw material-based components, decision-makers in companies thereby take into account specific raw material-specific availability risks, associated environmental impacts and social conditions in raw material-promoting countries. The content Conception of the sustainability-oriented raw material assessment model and visualization of the evaluation results Raw material evaluation based on economic, ecological and social indicators The target groups Dozierdeen und Studieren der Fachbereiche Resourcestrategie, Industrial Ecology und Sustainable Supply Chain Management Fach- und Eführer aus den Bereichen strategic Rohstoffinkauf und Produktgestaltung in Forschung und Entwicklung The author Christoph Kolotzek studied physics and is a research associate at the Chair for Production & Supply Chain Management at the University of Augsburg. In addition to questions in the area of production and logistics as well as resource-strategic concepts for forward-looking energy systems, he deals with the context of metallic raw materials.
content.title_en: Development of sustainability-oriented raw materials assessment to support decision-making processes in companies

content.text: Administrative autonomy in international organizations: A descriptive-comparative analysis. Public organizations and their autonomy -- The role of administrative staffs in the context of international organizations -- Theoretization of the autonomy of international administrations -- Operationalization and analysis of administrative autonomy. . Jörn Ege examines the autonomy of the secretariats of international government organizations (IOs) from a comparative perspective. Focusing on the internal structures, competences and resources of these "international bureaucracies," he analyses administrative autonomy in 16 IOs in a comparative study. The author makes visible the essential differences in administrative autonomy and concludes that autonomous administrations are subject to greater political control than administrations with low autonomy. The identification of bureaucratic potentials of influence shows important links for questions of legitimacy and effectiveness of management and governance beyond the national state. The content Public organisations and their autonomy The role of administrative staff in the context of international organizations Theoretization of the autonomy of international administrations Operationalization and analysis of administrative autonomy The target groups Researchers and students of comparative administrative science and the environment Public administration in the field of international administration is the administrative staff in international organizations.
content.title_en: Administrative autonomy in international organisations : A descriptive-comparative analysis

content.text: Theoretical basics of creativity: How new things arise in the brain and thus creative thinking becomes explainable. Anatomical basics -- Neuronal/cognitive processes -- Models of cognitive structures -- Science theoretical reflection in the light of constructive realism -- Model for understanding creativity. . Karl Testor creates a model based on a synthesis of different concepts of neuro- and cognitive science that offers an approach to the emergence of new things and develops the relevant aspects. The scientific consideration thus experiences an extension in the research of thought and creativity. From the model derivations are possible, which put a deeper experimental research on a clearly founded basis and various investigational designs to reflect better. The content Anatomical basics Neuronal/cognitive processes Models of cognitive structures Science theoretical reflection in the light of constructive realism Model for understanding creativity The target groups Dozierde and students of neuro-, cognitive and creativity sciences as well as the psychology Coaches/Mentors, mental trainer, psychologists The author Karl Testor is dealing with the theoretical and mentalities of the neuro-cognition academy and the neuro-reskilling of the faculty.
content.title_en: Cognition Theoretical Foundations of Creativity : How New Is Created in the Brain and thereby Creative Thinking becomes Explainable

content.text: The mathematical modelling in mathematics teaching -- categorization of student solutions -- thinking structures and difficulty -- development of a rating scheme. On the basis of actual student solutions, Xenia-Rosemarie Reit investigates difficult-generational aspects in the solution approaches of modelling tasks from a cognitive psychological perspective. To this end, she develops a method by which she identifies parallel or sequential thought operations based on the cognitive structure of solution approaches, in order to analyse the relationship between the thinking structure and difficulty of the solution approach and the modelling task.The author develops five modeling tasks, of which three were worked together in a booklet of 600 Gymnasial students of the ninth grade.The statistical analysis of these data confirms among other things the assumption that thought operations, which must be carried out in parallel within a solution approach, lead to a complication. The content of mathematical modelling in mathematics teaching Categorization of student structures and difficulty of a teacher's study program.
content.title_en: Thinking structures in solutions of modelling tasks : A cognitive psychological analysis of difficult aspects

content.text: User Experience in E-Commerce: Measuring Emotions in the Use of Interactive Applications. Interactive Applications -- From Usability to User Experience -- Customer Irrigation as UX Barrier -- Basic Emotional Psychology -- Mimics as an Indicator of Emotions -- Empirical Studies to Identify Mimic Expressions as an Indicator of Customer Irrigation. Emotional reactions of users to stimuli of an interactive application are considered central indicators of positive or negative user experience. Oliver Gast's study presents a method that enables the measurement and interpretation of emotions in the use of interactive applications. Because the success of web-based applications, such as online shops, depends to a very large extent on the fulfilment of the expectations of the individual user. With the results of his study, the author has created and evaluated a model that comprehensively shows the relevant indicators for mimics based emotion assessment. The content Interactive Applications From Usability to User Experience Customer Irrigation as a UX Barrier Basic Emotional Psychology Mimics as an Indicator of Emotional Management of the Business Department.
content.title_en: User Experience in e-commerce : Measuring emotions in the use of interactive applications

content.text: Further education as a human resource development. Studies without abstinence, further education -- academicization -- crediting of professional competences -- type formation. . Peggy Renger shows that with the opening of universities, further training initiatives for graduates of advanced education can also be established. Her study notes that new target group-appropriate study programmes are necessary for this purpose, which are made more flexible and also integrate the work curriculum – because from the company's perspective, the support of lifelong learning is as important as necessary. The different environmental dynamics require to focus on the existing human resources. Increasingly, a strategic and consistent personnel management will be required, which not only trains the own young people, but also promotes their skills development to maintain their professional ability. The content of studies without abstinence, further education academic studies Academization of vocational competences Type formation < The target groups Dozierde and students of the educational sciences, adult education and business sciences Practitioners from the personnel management and further education The author Peggy Renger studied at the TU Chemnitz the combination of the master courses of adult education/in-company further education and further education is currently active in the field of human resources management.
content.title_en: Scientific training as a human resources development

content.text: Protection of the rights of the Internet against evaluation portals on the Internet. The work deals with the development of solutions in the field of protection of the rights of the Internet against evaluation portals. Evaluation portals are among the modern phenomena on the Internet and are always at the center of judicial decisions. In addition to a presentation of the current factual and legal situation, the focus of the work is on the development of solutions, the tension between the rights of the persons concerned resulting from this type of digital opinion and the tension between these rights. In the context of the further development of the protection standard of the rights of the Internet, a look beyond the German borders is also taken into consideration. In addition to the specific features of the Internet medium, the case law on comparative tests of goods and the English "fair comment" regulation are also included in the review.
content.title_en: Protection of opinions against online evaluation portals

content.text: Promoting a second-tier protection regime for innovation of small and medium-sized enterprises in South Asia : the case of Sri Lanka.The term utility model is still largely unexplored in Sri Lanka and other parts of South Asia to encourage innovation by SMEs.The author examines whether these countries could benefit from a second-tier patent scheme tailored to the specific characteristics of the country's innovation landscape.
content.title_en: Promoting a second-tier protection regime for innovation of small and medium-sized enterprises in South Asia : the case of Sri Lanka

content.text: Efficiency Analysis of Service Productions: A Data Development Analysis taking into account stochastic external factors. Regina Schlindwein analyses the production of services from a production theoretical point of view and develops new methods for measuring efficiency that take account of the influence of external factors. Through the efficiency assessment, the author reveals performance deficits of individual service providers that represent the starting point for possible performance improvements. As service productions are stochastic, they are described by multivariately distributed activities, so that methods of stochastic mathematical programming, especially the chance constrained programming, are used to calculate efficiency measures.The content Selected DEA models: CCR model and BCC model Stochastic efficiency concepts Development of a stochastic service activity DEA technology quantities for stochastic productions Chance-Constrained technology quantity The target groups Dozierde and students of the economic sciences with the focus on Operations Research, Production or Service Management Practitioners and Professionals who deal with efficiency measurement The author Dr. Regina Schlindwein is a PhD student at the University of Karlsruhe.
content.title_en: Efficiency analysis of service productions : Data development analysis taking into account stochastic external factors

content.text: Disadvantage and deposit retention in the factual group: an examination of the differences and interactions on the basis of intra-group foreign financing transactions. After the introduction of a balance sheet approach in § 57 AktG, the existing actual co-operation of §§ 311, 57 AktG requires a thorough examination. The author shows that the inferiority-protecting § 311 AktG also has a further scope of application than § 57 AktG and is delimited from it. The actual comparison is carried out on the basis of certain foreign financing transactions in different constellations, which as so-called "multi-act legal transactions" can contain several disadvantages or advantages. This leads to a clear delimitation of the various protection areas as well as a detailed presentation of the application area of the accounting approach and the third-party comparison. In the follow-up to the BGH-principle "Third stock exchange course", the author develops his own requirements for compensation transactions within the framework of § 57 AktG and limits the compensation of the disadvantage compensation in § 311 AktG.
content.title_en: Disadvantage and deposit guarantee in the factual group: an investigation into the differences and interactions between intra-group debt financing operations

content.text: Fair Use in German and European copyright law? : a comparative study on the flexibilisation of the copyright catalogue following the example of the US Fair Use doctrine. A flexibleization of the too rigid catalogue of barriers of German and European copyright law is urgently required. This is particularly evident in the confrontation of barriers with novel forms of work use. In contrast, within the framework of the fair use barrier of US copyright, which is designed to be technologically neutral and open to evaluation, it is possible to achieve a much more easily, even a changed work usage reality. Comparatively, the author examines how, from findings on the Fair Use barrier and the copyright three-step test established in European and international law, a catch-up general clause can be created which could give the necessary flexibility without appearing as a foreign body in European law, to the rigid limits of the InfoSoc directive or the UrhG
content.title_en: Fair Use in German and European Copyright?: a comparative study on the flexibilisation of the copyright catalogue of barriers, modelled on the US Fair Use doctrine

content.text: Evaluation portals on the Internet. Evaluation portals on the Internet are among the most controversial forms of modern expression at present. While some see this as a contribution to greater transparency, others warn against the emergence of "digital pillors". The acute investigation involves a comprehensive examination of all civil law issues related to the operation and use of evaluation portals. One focus is on the development of criteria, which enable the conflicting interests of the participants in the portal operation to be weighed against each other. In this respect, the credo of the protection of anonymity on the Internet is put to the test. In addition, the fairness and data protection implications of evaluation portals on the Internet are discussed in depth. Finally, the focus is on the question of the liability of portal operators. To this extent, a deeper examination of the regulations of the TMG and the Institute of Störerhaftung takes place.
content.title_en: Evaluation portals on the Internet

content.text: The notarial obligation to provide information in the case of unsecured pre-services. The BGH assigns the obligation to provide information twice as much as the obligation to provide information in the case of unsecured pre-services from the legal obligation to provide information in accordance with § 17 para. 1 BeurkG at the latest since 1994. This refusal of the notary's obligation to provide information to the supervisor means a stronger obligation of the notary and an enhancement of its protective function and has practical relevance. In the examination of reasons, consequences and justification of this change of jurisdiction, the author first considers the development of the legal basis and prepares the case law of the RG and BGH to the case-group of unsecured pre-services. Finally, it deals with the dogmatic distinction and systematization of legal obligation and duty to provide information and explains why the notarial obligation to provide information in the case of unsecured pre-services is sufficient to provide information in accordance with § 14 para. 1 p. 2 BNotO.
content.title_en: Notary information requirements for unsecured intermediate consumption

content.text: Restructuring of bonds under the new bond-writing law. Bonds have experienced enormous growth in importance as a means of corporate financing in recent decades. In 2009 German bond-writing law was amended. Opportunities for subsequent changes in bond conditions have been considerably expanded to facilitate the restructuring of non-performing bonds. The work analyses the regulatory framework of such restructurings and examines whether an appropriate balance between the majority's ability to act and the protection of the minority is ensured. It shows that the reform has made German bond-writing law internationally competitive again and has created an attractive legal framework for bond issues.
content.title_en: Restructuring of bonds under the new bond law

content.text: Cultural flatrates: Remuneration mechanisms for network-based use of copyrighted objects. In the digitalised world, the habits and needs of users plunge the traditional copyright into crisis. In order to supposedly save the rights of authors and other rights holders, the term cultural flatrate calls for the introduction of extensive freedoms in the digital use of copyrighted objects. Wolfgang Zwengel, with his work, puts a snare in the thicket of the discussions on such a further development of copyright law and provides the reader with a detailed overview of the discussed regulatory models and their feasibility under the current legal framework. The author systematizes the proposals, which are partly highly different from each other, discusses their implementation into the German copyright system and examines their compatibility with German constitutional law, the law of the European Union and international treaties in the field of copyright.
content.title_en: Cultural flatrates : remuneration mechanisms for network-based use of copyrighted property

content.text: Patentability of chemical selection inventions : :the olanzapine and escutalopram decisions. The work deals with selection inventions with the recent decisions of the BGH on the patentability of chemical compounds. Comparatively, the author describes the impact of this case law on the development of patent laws and similar court decisions in the main legal systems. The presentation is also particularly helpful for selection inventions in the pharmaceutical industry.
content.title_en: Patentability of chemical selection inventions : the olanzapine and escutalopram decisions

content.text: The work addresses legal aspects of increasing vehicle automation. After an introduction to the topic, a legal analysis of registration and liability law issues in connection with automated vehicles follows. Within the scope of the registration examination, obstacles to registration are dealt with at both international and national level. The focus is on the Vienna Convention on Road Traffic. The revision of this agreement and its importance for national law are examined. In the context of the liability test, three questions are answered: The question of liability for illegal traffic behaviour by means of automated vehicles, the question of liability for road traffic accidents using automated vehicles and the question of liability for faulty automated vehicles in the sense of a product defect. The paper concludes with findings from this analysis and an outlook
content.title_en: Automated vehicles in the light of Swiss registration and liability law

content.text: Transnational data protection : Global data protection standards through self-regulation. While the Internet has led to a globalization of data flows, data protection law remains internationally inconsistent. Since a worldwide binding, comprehensive data protection law is not achievable at this time, there is a need to respond with new regulatory concepts. Global standards through self-regulation can be a pragmatic solution. In this context, various variants of self-regulation with increasing state participation are examined: pure self-regulation, regulated self-regulation and co-regulation
content.title_en: Transnational data protection : Global data protection standards through self-regulation

content.text: The paper presents solutions and approaches to the regulation of the constitutional and fundamental rights of the organ allocation. In this respect, the requirements of the constitution and fundamental rights for the organ allocation are developed beforehand and then checked for compliance with them.A key role is played in this regard in particular by the democratic principle and the right to physical integrity.The work is intended to provide the legislator with assistance to revise the existing regulation.The author focuses on medical law within her legal activities and is concerned with the problems of the current legal situation in practical application.
content.title_en: Constitutionality of the right of the organ allocation

content.text: The right of the accused to effective defence: an analysis of the status quo and proposals for quality assurance. The right of the accused to effective defence is an elementary part of any legal system in society. The importance of this right increases proportionally to the scope of the possibilities of defence to influence the outcome of the criminal trial. In view of the re-ordering of the German criminal procedure – inter alia by shifting the weights into the investigation procedure and the possibilities of understanding – the question of whether and how the criminal proceedings allow and promote high-quality criminal defense must be re-issued. The paper tries to answer this question by analysing the status quo of the state of defence, providing reasons for the existing legal situation and at the same time, taking into account the dangers of the static of the criminal process, proposals to strengthen the accused's right to effective defence through quality assurance measures.
content.title_en: The right of the accused to effective defence: an analysis of the status quo and proposals for quality assurance

content.text: Whistleblower : Decision-making, reporting and criminal evaluation. How and why (former) employees who have knowledge of organisational maladministration become whistleblowers and what potential for investigation and control they have in particular in economic crime is dealt with in detail for the first time in German-speaking countries. She presents the findings from 28 qualitative interviews with whistleblowers and silent insiders as well as 10 others with relatives of (punishment) prosecution authorities, ombuds lawyers etc. In detail, the work provides among other things: four types of personality with different whistleblowing probability; the ex- and intrinsic situational and decision dynamics in an objective and subjective whistleblowing history model; the relevant decision-making and causal factors and their external stimulability in practice; Implications for further whistleblowing research and legislation
content.title_en: Whistleblower : Decision-making, reporting and criminal evaluation

content.text: Law enforcement in social networks: Facebook & Co. as modern investigative tools. Due to the growing technisation of all areas of life, the authorities are increasingly dependent on investigations in the digital space. The use of the new media is therefore of particular relevance for law enforcement authorities. There are numerous possibilities of using these methods, which can be divided into four main types of action: the collection of publicly accessible data, access to non-public data, the use of virtual investigators and finally the search. In this regard, the criminal procedure regulations were to be investigated on suitable authorisation bases, which poses the user with no insignificant legal problems by overlapping three different legal disciplines. This interlinking of constitutional, data protection and criminal law makes it clear that the balancing act between the protection of fundamental freedoms and the duty of the state to effective prosecution is not an easy one.
content.title_en: Law enforcement in social networks : Facebook & Co. as modern investigative tools

content.text: The domestic act : the fact of § 9 para. 1 Var. 3 StGB. Cross-border crime is not least an expression of progressive globalization. This applies in addition to the possible "Internet crime", especially for economic crime. German courts regularly ask whether German criminal law is applicable to the acts. § 9 para. 1 Var. 3 StGB applies German criminal law, among other things, when a success which is part of the event occurs in Germany. The interpretation of this rule of place of success is still disputed. The work presents the problematic groups of cases and tries to solve these under development of uniform concepts and taking into account international law.
content.title_en: The domestic act : the operative event of § 9 (1) Var. 3 StGB

content.text: The use of covert investigators to unlock the confession of an accused person: A test stone for the prohibition of deception in § 136a StPO and the nemo-tenetur principle from Art. 6 ECHR. While the StPO provides a definition of the covered investigator (VE), it regulates his activities in a highly incomplete manner. It is precisely for this reason that it is necessary to examine whether § 136a StPO also applies to the use of VE when it is used to unlock the confession of the accused person. Consideration should be given to the prohibition of deception. In practice, law enforcement authorities are increasingly using secret investigation methods to investigate alleged crimes. However, the research question under investigation cannot be assessed in the light of the German legal situation. In this respect, the Leading Case of the EGMR could serve as a model. The criminal procedural VE regulations then act as a test stone for the prohibition of deception in § 136a para. 1 StPO and the freedom of self-burdening from Art. 6 ECHR.
content.title_en: Use of hidden investigators to elicit the confession of an accused person : A test for the prohibition of deception of § 136a StPO and the nemo-tenetur principle of Art. 6 ECHR

content.text: The conclusion of the action of co-indicators (§ 25 paragraph 2 StGB) : Extended rule as a basis for calculation - an empirical based investigation. The dissertation deals – as far as is evident – with the exact requirements of the joint decision. This is surprising under the premise that the joint decision to act is the "base of the assignment of foreign contributions and thus the constitution of co-indication.The work deals first with the ratio of the assignment and defines it as "extended rule of action". However, the work does not stop, but rather it also empirically proves the extended rule of action with the help of reference sciences. From this established model of reasoning, the disseration in a second part draws the conclusions for the exact requirements of the joint decision to act in a formal, contentual and temporal way. In this context it also addresses various forms of co-indication.
content.title_en: The conclusion of the action of co-operators (§ 25 paragraph 2 StGB) : Extended rule of action as a basis for calculation - an empirically supported investigation

content.text: The UK's farewell to the coal electricity industry: The application of a European electricity market model. Philip Mayer provides a sound insight into the structure of the British electricity system and analyses the impact of Britain's planned complete abandonment of coal electricity generation by using a European electricity market model. The research takes into account various potential development paths for the future European electricity system. The author also highlights potential interactions with the UK's exit from the European Union to put the results of modelling in the context of current policy events. The content • Historical development of the energy industry in the UK • Objective of future energy and environmental policy • Future development paths of the electricity industry • Development of the costs of electricity generation and wholesale prices • Impact on environmental and climate protection • Qualitative assessment of scenarios with regard to Brexit The target groups • Teachers and students of economics, energy industry, renewable energy and the study programmes Energy management and systems, environmental management and political sciences • Practitioners and practitioners from the fields of energy market modeling, European electricity markets, system research, environmental research and development of the industry.
content.title_en: United Kingdom's farewell to coal electricity : The application of a European electricity market model

content.text: The creation of a Uniform Patent Court : The EPGÜ and the jurisdiction of the courts in the transitional period. Julia Merkle examines the relationship between the national courts and the European patent court in the transitional period after the entry into force of the EPGÜ (Convention on a Uniform Patent Court) and the implications for plaintiffs. Before the Uniform Patent Court is competent exclusively for European patents, actions can continue to be brought before a national court. Various judicial systems work parallelly for a certain period of time. The content The current patent dispute system The future Uniform Patent Dispute System The jurisdiction of the courts in the transitional period The target groups Teaching staff and students with the focus on commercial law and industrial law Lawyers and specialist lawyers in the field of patent law and EU law The author Julia Merkle completed her master's degree in commercial law (MBL) at BTU Cottbus.
content.title_en: The creation of a Single Patent Court : The EPG and the jurisdiction of the courts during the transitional period

content.text: The study of the knock behaviour of methane-based fuels is based on the analysis of the mechanical and synthetic properties of the methane-based fuels, but different composition. The results show systematic deviations in the assessment of the real knock resistance by the methane number (MZ) and combustion effects, which differ significantly from the expected knock resistance.Only by novel evaluation criteria and algorithms could the author evaluate the observed effects quantitatively and qualitatively.The content of the state of the art: methane fuels, reaction kinetic basics of the motor knock resistance evaluation and knock detection conduction and description of the modified knock detection and evaluation algorithm Evaluation of the transferability of the methane number based on the actual knock behaviour of the fuels Description and interpretation of the observed atypical knock phenomena The target groups Dozierde and students of the automotive technology, in particular in the field of engine technology Users in the engine development sector The author Sebastian Scharlipp is responsible for the research of the Institute of Thermodynamics and the research team of the German Institute of Technology for Energy Engineering.
content.title_en: Investigation of the knock-on behaviour of methane-based fuels

content.text: The author's empirical study in Germany and the USA shows that taxi drivers can reliably assess their trustworthiness through an interaction process (mainly verbal) with passengers. At the same time, there is the chance to influence positively the emergence of trust. The author shows how important a professional examination of the central factor in service communication within the issue of trust is. The content Historical and current aspects of trust issues Personal services in the context of modern uncertainty in the everyday life of taxi drivers (overtakes and violence) Communication processes as a special success factor Recommendations for professional service delivery The target groups Researchers, teachers and students of sociology, social sciences and economics Practitioners in the service industry The author Branko Woischwill has a PhD in trust at the JFK Institute for North American Studies, Department of Sociology, Freie Universität Berlin. Here he works as a lecturer in the field of sociology, social sciences and economics Practitioner in the service industry.
content.title_en: Trust and communication in a service: a process-oriented study

content.text: Effectuation or Causation? : The influence of the personality of inexperienced entrepreneurs. Sebastian Eberz develops "FSim" as an interactive, scenario-based computer simulation that allows for effective and causal behavior in a virtual environment and makes it tangible. It is shown that the effectuation approach as a modern entrepreneurship theory and alternative to the traditional approach (causation) has only initially addressed the role of personality for the founding behavior. Moreover, experienced entrepreneurs are primarily in the foreground. However, the theoretical analysis and an empirical study carried out show that even inexperienced entrepreneurs have fundamentally effective and causal behavior, which is influenced by personality depending on environmental uncertainty. The content Causation & Effectuation: Classical and Modern in Entrepreneurship Environment and Personality as behavioral determinants FSim as a reference framework for determining effectuative and causal behavior.
content.title_en: Effectuation or Causation? : The Influence of the Personality of Inexperienced Entrepreneurs

content.text: The protection of personal data in the cloud. What are the barriers to data protection that private users and companies must overcome when using cloud services? The focus of this work is on the assignment of responsibility, order data processing and liability issues in international private law. These questions are answered in the context of European regulations.
content.title_en: Protection of personal data in the cloud

content.text: The network neutrality of the Basic Law. The criteria used to transfer data on the Internet and to what extent network operators are able to intervene in data transport have already become key questions for digital society. This book uses the basic law's requirements to establish guidelines and to show the relationship between technically feasible and legally acceptable.The ongoing digitalisation and the associated convergence of content and networks makes the regime of data transport increasingly important.The structures that may be affected by an influence in data transport are diverse and interactive.This work categorizes various types of possible network management and assesses these in terms of their consequences, in particular on the basis of fundamental rights and compares the requirements thus identified with the national legal framework.
content.title_en: The Net Neutrality of the Basic Law

content.text: Love and power in the German-American security relationship 2001-2003: a critical-realistic discourse analysis. Why is cooperation changing into conflict? How can the dynamic change in the German-American security structure in Afghanistan and Iraq be explained? This problem goes far beyond the concrete subject matter, but it also touches on fundamental questions: for example, the relationship between the actor and structure or of ideas and matter. The possibilities and limits of scientific analysis also require reflection. Based on Critical Realism, Tim Griebel poses these questions and reconstructs the dynamics of love and power within a historical security structure using a corpuslinguistic critical-realistic discourse analysis.
content.title_en: Love and Power in the German-American Security Relationship 2001-2003 : a Critical-Realist Discourse Analysis

content.text: Accessibility in a virtual space: Use-centered and model-driven development of web surfaces. With the help of modern technologies such as standard architectures and the Unified Modeling Language, Helmut Vieritz presents the barrier-free usability as a complex requirement holistically.The description of the relationship between operating tasks, dialog presentation and web architecture provides software architects and web developers with an understanding of how to comply with the accessibility requirements already in the design and avoid costly subsequent changes. An in-depth case study and further applications round off the presentation.The content Requirements survey for the design of a barrier-free web surface Modelling barrier-free web surfaces Application case: Design of an barrier-free web surface for an integration system The target groups of lecturers and students of computer science, software and web engineering and human-computer interaction (HCI) software engineers and architects, web developers - web and software engineering, human-computer interaction The author Helmut Vieritz conducts research and teaches at RWTH Aachen University in the areas of web engineering, human-computer interaction, e-learning and accessibility. The barrier-free application of the user interface of a web interface for the application and publication process of a web interface.
content.title_en: Accessibility in virtual space: Use-centered and model-driven development of web interfaces

content.text: Effectiveness in online communication: An investigation of customer online journeys. Effectiveness of online communication measures -- Behavioural analysis of communication -- Communication effect and success -- Purchase decision processes on the Internet -- Conceptual foundations of customer online journeys -- Logit choice models. Alexander Kolano analyses cross-channel effects of online communication measures and combines behavioral, decision-oriented and system-theoretical explanations. Based on a theoretical reference framework, he analyses a comprehensive hypothesis framework using secondary statistical clickstream data using logit models. The author derives from the results of the study Implications for improving the effectiveness of online communication measures. The content • Effectiveness of online communication measures • Behavioral analysis of communication • Communication effect and success < • Purchase decision processes on the Internet • Conceptual foundations of customer online journeys • Logit choice models The target groups • Dozende and students in the areas of marketing and communication research • Communication effect and success • Purchasing decision processes on the Internet • Conceptual assessment of customer online journeys • Communication models at the University of the University of Applied Sciences and Humanities.
content.title_en: Effectiveness in online communication : An investigation of customer online journeys

content.text: Dr. Michael Tretter is working on the field of tension between companies, regions, locations and companies and analyses questions about location and regional development from the perspective of a multinational company. He shows approaches with which companies can strategically use the location-specific strengths and development potential of the various location regions. This utilization requires a long-term spatial and social integration in the location regions, so that it makes sense to accompany internationalization strategies with regional location strategies. The content Location strategies – the approach of location Excellence Regional business engagement Influencing factors, organization and coordination of location and regional development Regional embedding as an opportunity for a new location The target groups Dozierdeen and students of economic geography, business administration and location management are responsible for regional and location management, corporate responsibility, sustainability management, corporate strategy The author Michael Tretter has been working at the Chair of Tourism/Centre for Entrepreneurship at the Catholic University Eichch-Ingolstadt. He is today in the field of business strategy/sustainability for a large-scale automotive manufacturer.
content.title_en: Location and regional development as a strategic task of multinational companies : An entrepreneurial perspective on regional contexts

content.text: Digital Signage at the Point of Sale: Psychological and behavioural effects of different types of content. Sandra Manzinger examines the conditions under which digital signage (DS), the use of flat screens for the communication of certain content, can be used successfully in the food trade. She examines the question of what cognitive, emotional and behavioural effects result from the use of DS in food retail and which DS content these effects are maximized. The author tests these potentials of effects by means of two field studies in a real shopping situation in the product and checkout area. The results of these studies show that DS influences the cognition and emotions of consumers in both areas. Particularly valuable is the realization that DS can reduce negative emotions. The content • Testing of different digital signage contents • Psychic, cognitive and emotional effects of DS • Behavioral effects of DS The target groups • Lecturers and students of business economics with the focus on marketing • Specialists and executives in the area of marketing, a. in the retail sector The author Sandra Manzinger, MSc studied marketing at the University of Vienna as a department of research and the Department of Business.
content.title_en: Digital Signage at the Point of Sale : Psychological and behavioural effects of different types of content

content.text: Optimization of the heat dissipation of a vehicle electric motor and effects on the overall cooling circuit. Nikolaos Karras deals with the reduction of the cooling energy requirement of battery electric vehicles as a contribution to the increase in range. The core aspect here is the investigation of new, more efficient water jacket geometries for electric motors, which have a high heat dissipation and at the same time low pressure loss. In addition to common geometries alternative structures are also examined. The analysis and evaluation is carried out purely numerically by a validated 3D simulation tool. Further cooling circuit and vehicle parameters are considered for additional relief of the vehicle energy storage. For the evaluation of the individual measures a 1D simulation environment of the electric vehicle is used. Its validation is carried out by means of climate wind tunnel and route tests. Finally, the basic vehicle configuration is compared with the optimized vehicle configuration. The content of development tools of the thermomanagement optimization of the heat dissipation of an electric motor motor and the overall cooling system The target groups Dozierende and students of the vehicle technology and thermomanagement practice in the field of automotive engineering at the University of Stuttgart.
content.title_en: Optimisation of the heat dissipation of a vehicle electric motor and effects on the overall cooling circuit

content.text: Alternative fuels for diesel-powered combustion from biomass containing carbohydrate and based on bio- and chemical-catalytic production methods. Linda Witzke is concerned with the question of how carbohydrate-based biomass can be used as a raw material for the production of alternative diesel fuels. Using the example of selected fuels, possible bio- and chemical-catalytic production methods from sugar are designed and investigated using a comparative evaluation methodology in terms of process feasibility and process balances as well as fuel production costs. The study shows that these alternative diesel fuels have beneficial ignition properties, but do not currently achieve economic competitiveness in comparison with fossil diesel fuels.The content content.text: Problem solving and math learning: To the benefit of experimenting and error. Anna-Christin Söhling describes the acquisition of knowledge during the problem solving process by trying and exposing errors. In doing so, she uses the concept network of deduction, abduction and induction according to Peirce (1903) and Meyer (2007). Mathematical problem solving processes are often characterized by experimentation and erroneous approaches. Nevertheless, students do not seem to come to a solution only by mere chance. In addition to the philosophical-logical reconstruction of similar processes, the author deals with the question of learning mathematics through problem solving. The content From experimenting to structural understanding From error learn possibilities and limits of knowledge gain in problem solving theory of logical final forms according to Peirce The target groups Dozierende und Studieren der Mathematik und Mathematik Didaktik Mathematikleleleleleleleleinin und -lehrer The author Anna-Christin Söhling is working as a scientific employee at the University of Cologne. There she works for the logical-philosophical reconstruction of learning processes, especially for problem solving problems of the problem solving of the problem.
content.title_en: Problem solving and learning mathematics : To the benefit of trying and error

content.text: Mobility of families in rural areas: division of labour, routines and typical strategies for coping. Based on current empirical findings, Melanie Herget develops recommendations for sustainable transport systems in rural areas. Based on problem-centered interviews with mothers and fathers in two rural regions as well as on the basis of the Protection Motivation Theory, the author develops convictions, routines and typical strategies for managing families in West and East Germany in relation to their everyday mobility.These qualitative results are complemented by quantitative analyses of the study "Mobility in Germany 2008-
content.title_en: Mobility of families in rural areas : division of labour, routines and typical strategies for coping

content.text: The EU's development law provides a framework for coherence. This work is the first to be comprehensively and from a legal point of view, which means the much described but little-declared coherence requirement in development cooperation for the European Union's policy-making. To date, the Union has tortuously torpedoed its efforts in developing countries through its own association, trade, agriculture, fisheries and common foreign and security policy, which often at the expense of the poorest countries. The coherence requirement now enshrined in Article 208 TFEU not only obliges the EU within development policy to focus on the objective of poverty reduction, but also requires it to align all policy areas in principle to this objective and thus codifies the principle of development in the context of the EU's external action. The author derives from this concrete directions for action for each policy field, whose attention can lead to better and more effective development cooperation.
content.title_en: The need for coherence in the European Union's development law

content.text: Multilingualism and method : the use of the principle of linguistic equality in Union law. A right in 24 language versions: How does the European judiciary implement the requirement of equal treatment of all language versions in practice?The principle of linguistic equality may have been fulfilled at the beginning of the European Community with its four founding official languages, but is practically impossible to implement in the meanwhile six-fold number of languages. Nevertheless, the European Court of Justice continues to use the procedural formulas for the methodological handling of the multi-lingually binding Union law from the beginning of its case law.The work establishes a considerable discrepancy between the methodological claim of linguistic equality and the practice of jurisprudence between 2004 and 2008 and develops proposals for a more practical handling of the multi-lingually binding Union law.
content.title_en: Multilingualism and method : dealing with the principle of linguistic equality in Union law

Kornberger designs a complex disorder model of delusion and hallucinations based on empirical findings, as often occur in the context of psychosis from the schizophrenic range of forms.The resulting interventions represent an innovative treatment form in the form of systemtheoretical-psychological therapy (SPT) which is described in detail.The content Theoretical basics of delusion and hallucination Results of efficacy and intervention research An innovative disorder model for delusion and hallucinations Systemtheoretical-psychological therapy (SPT) in detail Evaluation of the efficacy of SPT The target groups Dozierde and students of psychotherapy, behavioural therapy, clinical psychology and psychiatry Psychotherapists, psychologists, specialists for psychiatry, scientists in the fields of schizophrenia and system theory The author Dr. Manfred W. Kornberger is active as a clinical psychologist and psychotherapist in the field of the Vienna Department of Distinction for Disinfective Therapy.
content.title_en: System theoretic-psychological therapy for the treatment of delusion and hallucinations

content.text: The study of the basic and state of the art of the technology -- construction and condition of the simulation model -- results and discussion, validation and thermomanagement measures -- sensitivity analysis. Benjamin Stegmann examines and validates a one-dimensional simulation model, which was used to investigate the thermal behaviour of combustion-engined vehicles mainly in the hot-run phase. The most important parameters in the determination of the driving resistance and engine operating point are subjected to a sensitivity analysis in order to categorize and prioritize their influence. The model is validated by means of measurements of two vehicles in the thermowind channel and in a climate chamber. In addition to the basic configuration, thermomanagement measures are implemented in measurement and simulation on both vehicles to investigate their effects on fluid and component temperatures as well as fuel consumption. The author concludes with an outlook on parameters that can influence the energy balance of motor vehicles in alternative drive concepts. The content of basics and state of technology<structure and="bedatung=" of the "dimension model of the thermodynamics and the field of study analysis in the field of study.
content.title_en: A contribution to the modeling accuracy in the area of one-dimensional simulation of passenger car cooling systems

content.text: The study examines the concepts of primary school children in terms of negative numbers: metaphernanalytically oriented explorations in the context of didactic reconstruction. Christian Rütten examines in his study the concepts of primary school children in terms of negative numbers before their teaching thematicization and in which relationship these are related to technical perspectives such as numerical straight or equivalence class models. The research framework serves as the model of didactic reconstruction with the central research tasks: technical clarification, understanding of the learner's perspective and didactic structuring. To measure the learning perspective, the author illuminates psychological and mathematical didactic perspectives and locates the learning perspective in the cognitive layer structure. He measures metaphors as cognitive structures and develops accordingly a reconstructive metaphor analysis as an evaluation method. An empirical study with over 500 primary school children shows a wide spectrum of pre-educated concepts for secondary school teachers and opens perspectives for teaching design and further research contexts.
content.title_en: View of primary school children on negative numbers : metaphernologically oriented explorations in the context of didactic reconstruction

content.text: The author identifies the shortcomings of the current legal situation and seeks to resolve them. The work spans a broad spectrum of legal aspects from the application of German criminal law in foreign operations to prosecution obligations and jurisdiction (in particular after § 11a StPO), to specific aspects of investigations. -- Central concern is to create a basis for effective and legal criminal investigations in foreign operations. To this end, the mission of field hunters as investigators of the public prosecutor's office is proposed. Stam analyses the simple legal and constitutional and international law admissibility and shows advantages over current practice. Finally, the work contains concrete legislative proposals to implement the planned solution.
content.title_en: Law enforcement in criminal offences of Bundeswehr soldiers in foreign operations

content.text: Information-oriented controlling of service-oriented information systems : Success factors of flexible IT applications. Under the approach of value-oriented corporate management, Florian Werner researches the value drivers that are based on the concept of service-oriented architecture (SOA). He systematically analyzes the design fields of management with the greatest influence on the company value. Integrating insights of information management and IV controlling, the author identifies key benefits, costs and risks of service-oriented information systems (SOIS) and combines them in a consistent performance measurement model. The study includes a balanced scorecard (BSC) with all SOA levels and corresponding key performance indicators (KPI). The content: • Value-oriented information management • Value-oriented IV controlling • Service-oriented architecture • Performance measurement of service-oriented information systems. The target groups: • Dozende und Studierende in den Bereichen BWL und Wirtschaftsinformatik • Prakterner im Bereich Strategicens Management, Informationsmanagement, IV-Controlling, IT und Fachstelles Author: Dr. Florian-Wert-Orientierungs-Wertungs-Prof.
content.title_en: Value-oriented controlling of service-oriented information systems : Success factors of flexible IT applications

content.text: State-based companies: the problem of the allocation of international investment law and other areas of international law. State-based companies as hybrid actors operating between public and private spheres have been dealing with law and practice for a long time. Currently, the question of the assignment of the actions of such companies to the state is increasingly posed, especially in international investment law. Because if an investor is damaged by a state-based company, it is protected by investment law and/or other international standards only if the business actions can be regarded as such of the state.The author analyses the criteria on which the question of the assignment of actions is to be assessed. To this end, an analysis of the rules of the customary international law as well as a comprehensive evaluation of the case law of investment arbitration courts, the World Trade Organization, the European Court of Human Rights and the European Court of Justice are discussed.
content.title_en: State-owned enterprises: the problem of allocation in international investment law and other areas of international law

content.text: The report highlights the importance of compliance management systems. The author outlines innovative approaches and defines operational requirements for certification as a value-added measure of (criminal) compliance. He first explains fundamental questions and abstracts essential requirements for a compliance management system. Then, he develops meaningful criteria for certification standards. He then examines the legal and actual implications of such certification. Finally, he orders this measure in a regulatory context and develops a certificate model for reducing corruption in companies taking into account legal considerations. The author outlines innovative approaches and definitions of the operational requirements of the certification as a value-adding measure within the compliance of compliance management systems.
content.title_en: Certification as a measure of compliance (Criminal)

content.text: Climate Change and Security in the Arctic: Backgrounds, Perspectives, Strategies. Why the Arctic? -- Climate Change, Security and Strategy -- Arctic Precedence? The North Polar Region today -- Climate Change and Security: Arctic Strategies in Comparison -- Arctic Security at the Beginning of the Anthropocene. Golo M. Bartsch considers the security-political impact of climate change in the Arctic in a unique way so far in German-speaking research. From an interdisciplinary perspective, he combines current natural and social science insights into the profound change of the high north and compares political strategies of the eight neighbouring states, NATO and the EU. Thus, the Arctic is currently also showing itself in the face of increasing military presence and stagnating relations between the western borderline and Russia as a more peaceful cooperation than conflict-oriented world region. The content The relationship between climate change and security The Arctic today: environment, resources, institutions military and conflict potentials in the polar sea Arctic strategy in comparison Arctic security: Conclusion and outlook The target groups teaching and students, especially in the field of political science/international relations The Arctic is a PhD in the field of environmental protection and military and military policy.
content.title_en: Climate change and Arctic security: backgrounds, perspectives, strategies

content.text: The research field "Media and Suicides" -- Definitions and Model Concepts of Suicideality and Depression -- Influences and Explanations in the Previous Research on Media and Suicides -- Modeling: Depression, Media and Suicides -- In the light of the numerous studies on the Werther effect, Sebastian Scherr brings together the theoretical overlaps of the model concept of depression and suicides into an integrative action theory model in the media context. He examines this with the help of empirical investigations. Depression, individual suicidality as well as media use, media reception and media perception play a central role. The study shows that suicide representations in the media do not have an equal, harmful effect on all recipients. Rather, a complex interaction between specific media use and individual personality characteristics is responsible for the influence media exert on individual suicidality. The content of the research field "Media and Suicides" Definitions of Suicides and Model Presentations of Communicationality in the Media Research Units of Depression and Media Research
content.title_en: Depression - Media - Suicide : On the empirical relevance of depression and media for suicide

content.text: Cloud computing: Challenge for the legal system. Cloud computing is one of the most important growth markets in the IT industry and promises significantly more efficient and cost-effective resource use. A determination and bestimability of the specific location of data processing is no longer necessary and often impossible. This poses new challenges to existing law, which regularly builds on constant factors such as the processing location. The work focuses on the question of whether and how the legal system adequately reconciles conflicting claims and interests of stakeholders, how legal uncertainty can be avoided and trust in cloud technology can be strengthened. The author discusses possible solutions for the legally compliant use of cloud services and examines aspects of contract and criminal law, copyright, data protection law and conflict law.The contribution is aimed at practice and research alike.
content.title_en: Cloud computing: challenge for the legal system

content.text: The teacher professors of mathematics are currently working on the subject of descriptive statistics: development and development of the test instrument BeSt Teacher with selected analyses. Stefanie Schumacher develops a theoretical framework model based on established models of professional knowledge, which includes the teacher self-efficacy and selected emotions in addition to technical and didactic knowledge related to descriptive statistics. The study includes the piloting of the test instrument BeSt Teacher, which was designed by the author, on a sample of 58 teachers working in the school service with quantitative and qualitative analyses.The results of the pilot study provide a detailed insight into the structure of the profession knowledge of mathematics teachers of secondary schools and also show further possibilities for using the test instrument.The content Models of teacher professors research Contents of the descriptive statistics Development and analysis of the test instrument BeSt Teacher The target groups of lecturers and students of mathematics didactics, education and psychology Teachers and their writings The author Stefanie Schumacher is a teacher of mathematics and English. She is a PhD student at the Institute of Mathematics of the University of Bielefeld.
content.title_en: Teacher's professional knowledge in the context of descriptive statistics : Development and structure of the test instrument BeSt Teacher with selected analyses

content.text: Nation-images and public trust between states: The change of the political image of Germany in the US-days 1999 to 2011. Melanie Breunlein shows the change of the political image of Germany and the confidence of nations towards Germany in six leading US-days between 1999 and 2011. As a theoretical basis she develops a nation-image-nation-trust model, which represents the processes of the emergence of both phenomena and possible connections between them. Using the newly developed instruments Nation Image Index and Nation Trust Index, nations-images and trust can be analyzed more systematically in the future.The author demonstrates theoretically and empirically how important confidence aspects are for the understanding and analysis of nation-images.The results contribute to the high image relevance of public trust in the future to the scientific focus.The content Nation-image Public confidence Nation-trust Nation Image Index Nation Trust Index The target groups Dozierende und Studierende der Kommunikations-, Medien- und Politikwissenschaft Executives in den Bereichen Public Diplomacy, Nation Branding, Politische Public Relations The author Dr. Melanie Breunlein has a PhD in Communication and Media Science at the University of Leipzig.
