content.text: Scalable unsupervised understanding for deep distortion generic models: novel variational algorithms and their software realizations. Efficient training of predictive generic models is a sought-after goal in machine learning. Discrete latent variables are often used to capture the generative process of real data, which has motivated research on discrete variational autoencoders (VAEs). Variationsal approximations of the EM algorithm provide a generic, powerful framework to derive training algorithms depending on the chosen form of variation distributions. Here we also use "truncated posteriors" as variation distributions and use the resulting training algorithm to establish a connection between evolutionary algorithms (EAs) and the training of deep generic models with binary latens. We also show that EA-based training of discrete VAEs a scalable and direct outcomes is possible.
content.title_en: Scalable unsupervised learning for deep discrete generative models : novel variational algorithms and their software realizations

content.text: Domain-specific languages for modelling and simulation. Simulation models and experiments are becoming more complex. One way to deal with this complexity is to develop software languages specializing in specific fields of application, so-called domain-specific languages (\emph{DSLs, domain-specific languages}). This paper examines how DSLs can be used in modelling and simulation. We look at various techniques for developing and implementing DSLs and illustrate their usefulness for expressing simulation models and experiments using some examples. <ger> Simulation models and simulation experiments are increasingly complex. One way to handle this complexity is developing software languages tailored to specific application domains, so-called domain-specific languages (DSLs). This thesis explores the potential of employing DSLs in modelling and simulation. We study different DST and experimenting for simulation.
content.title_en: Domain-specific languages for modeling and simulation

content.text: Simulation of the rotor dynamics of housingless flow machine systems with flexible rotor blades in the time range : Development of a modeling approach and experimental validation using a submersible motor agitator. The work presents a numerical method that enables the domain-wide simulation of rotor dynamics of electrically driven, housingless flow machines with flexible, spatially curved rotor blades in fluids. Electromechanical and structural dynamic processes are modelled with bond graphs. The structural dynamics correspond to an elastic multibody simulation (MBS). Fluid dynamics is modelled by an instationary vortex grid method (UVLM). Fluid and structural domains are coupled via a bidirectional FSI approach (MBS/UVLM).
content.title_en: Simulation of the rotor dynamics of housingless flow machine systems with flexible rotor blades in the time range : Development of a modeling approach and experimental validation using a submersible motor agitator

content.text: Micrometeorological measurements and numerical simulations of turbulence and evapotranspiration over agroforestry. Modern cropping is facing major challenges. The increasing occurrence of heat waves and long-lasting droughts leads to an excessive loss of soil water, an increased risk of wind and water erosion of soils and thus to loss of yield. Today's agricultural practices must therefore be reconsidered. The agroforestry industry (AF), which is a combination of perennial trees and grasslands or annual arable crops, has been shown to increase soil fertility and the binding of carbon dioxide in biomass and soil, reduces the risk of growing for wind and water erosion of soils, and decreases the frequency of heat waves and long-lasting noises leads to excessive loss of soil water.

content.text: Synthesis of potential pharmaceuticals and diagnostic markers for liver and pancreas diseases through photoredox catalysis and organic chemistry. This paper describes the first approaches for access to pharmaceutically relevant motives for the treatment of hereditary liver and pancreatic diseases. The photoredoxcatalysed decarboxylative foundry addition to electron-poor alkenes by means of pyrimidopteridine N-oxides is described. Furthermore, a photocatalytic hydro-aminating reaction of various syllable derivatives is presented. In addition, literature reports on total synthesis of rosiglitazone and lobeglitazone and ZD-0892 as well as two copper chemo sensors, CS3 and CPF1, were re-evaluated.
content.title_en: Synthesis of potential pharmaceuticals and diagnostic markers for liver and pancreas diseases through photoredox catalysis and organic chemistry

content.text: Diachronous legitimacy: the consistency of political orders as a challenge of democracy. It is said that good political orders are stable in time. At the same time, philosophical legitimacy theory claims with good reasons: Legitimate political orders are orders that are due to acts of self-legislative law. However, this does not apply to permanent political orders – even if they are liberal democracies: later generations find a constitutional order created by previous generations, which they often find difficult to change. Johannes Müller-Salo shows how the tension between stability and self-legislative law can be solved and how the ideal of democratic self-legislative law can be realized even within a permanent political order.
content.title_en: Diachronous legitimacy: the consistency of political orders as a challenge of democracy

content.text: Experimental development of an injection strategy for petrol engines with water injection. Water injection is a promising technology to increase the performance and efficiency of combustion engines. Direct water injection has many degrees of freedom, while indirect water injection is a technically feasible solution for short-term use. Maike Sophie Gern shows an improved combustion focus in spray and engine experiments with water injection as well as a reduction in exhaust gas temperature and nitrogen oxide emissions. At the same time, the unfavourable jet burst of water places high demands on the injection system and increases the unburnt hydrocarbons and particle emissions. The author's goal to achieve the greatest possible water efficiency is supported by an experimentally developed water efficiency. The content spray analysis analysis of motor operation with water injection Water efficiency and strategy recommendation The target groups Doziering and students of the vehicle drive department Developers of combustion engines, injection systems, exhaust gas treatment and alternative fuels The author Maike Sophie Gern has received a PhD in the field of vehicle injections at Technische Universität Berlin.
content.title_en: Experimental development of an injection strategy for petrol engines with water injection

content.text: The sediment transport in pressure pipes. The flow control of wastewater pump stations increases the risk of deposition in the pressure line due to reduced flow rate. For a pump station in northern Germany, the solid transport behaviour was investigated using laboratory tests (sedimentation, erosion), an online solid measurement and a 1D sediment transport simulation. Very slow sedimentation processes and extremely low erosion thrust stresses were shown. Finally, it was shown that safe operation of the pressure line and energy efficient pump control are compatible. <ger> Sewage pumping stations (PS) with flow control increase the risk of sediment formation inside the pressure pipe due to reduced flow velocities. The transport of solids was invested for a PS in northern Germany by means of mechanisms of laboratory tests (sedimentation & erosion), an online suspended assembly measurement and a 1D simulation.
content.title_en: Sediment transport in pressure pipes

content.text: Civil engagement for environmental protection in the city since 1970: Mainz – Wiesbaden – Freiburg im Breisgau. Environmental protection plays a central political role not only in the global context. It has long been a location factor at the urban level and is one of the core tasks of municipalities. But how can the rise of this policy field be explained? Matthias Lieb focuses on Mainz, Wiesbaden and Freiburg on how environmental protection and nature were negotiated in cities from 1970 onwards. The focus is on the civic engagement of associations, groups and initiatives and their occurrence in the cities and in environmental conflicts in the respective regions. Lieb uses detailed descriptions to highlight the differences in the political behavioural style of these groups. In their breadth, from conservative bird protectors to autonomous opponents of the runway West at Frankfurt Airport, they offered identification opportunities for the confrontation with issues of nature and environmental protection and contributed to a politicalization and popularization of environmental protection in the cities. At the same time, decisive roadmarks in the development of municipal environmental protection are identified, which in turn alter the framework conditions for environmental engagements.
content.title_en: Civil commitment to environmental protection in the city since 1970 : Mainz – Wiesbaden – Freiburg im Breisgau

content.text: Control of offshore wind farms with diode rectifier HVDC in a synthetic reference system. The work describes a control procedure for wind turbines in offshore wind farms with diode rectifier HVDC. Conventional synchronization to the local grid voltage is replaced by the specification of an external synchronization signal. All grid-side inverters of the offshore island network are thus operated in a common synthetic reference system.
content.title_en: Control of offshore wind farms with diode rectifier HVDC in a synthetic reference system

content.text: The suicide bombing in the picture: topicality and history of martyrs' records. Suicide bombings have always been accompanied by images and determined by them. From martyr posters to video testaments to computer simulations and live streams from the scene - the image productions of the militias are involved in the act in many ways and must be taken seriously as actors in the political field. Verena Straub shows for the first time the history of so-called martyr testimonies, which have been operating in various political contexts since the 1970s. In numerous case studies, she analyses their aesthetic and media spectrum, their action dimensions and gender policies, their artistic appropriations and ethical challenges.
content.title_en: The suicide bomb in the picture : Currentity and history of martyrs

content.text: Technological governance: the rise of network thinking in the crisis of modernity: Foucault, Luhmann and cybernetics. The network has become a fundamental concept of the 21st century – and with it the diagnosis that we live in a new age of connectivity, flexibility and self-organisation. In a large-scale history of government thinking, Vincent August first traces this fundamental transformation. He shows that our world is not only shaped by neoliberalism – and that the network society is not simply a result of the Internet or of computers. Instead, advisors: inside and outsiders such as Foucault, Crozier or Luhmann took back cybernetics to replace the world of ideas of sovereignty and fundamentally change our governance. An analysis of late modern societies does not work without an analysis of this network paradigm.
content.title_en: Technological governance : the rise of network thinking in the crisis of modernity : Foucault, Luhmann and cybernetics

content.text: Recycling - a means for what purpose? : Model-based determination of the energetic costs of metal recycling for an empirical comparison with primary extraction. In this open access book Philipp Schäfer criticizes the development of the circular economy towards an end in itself. In order to ensure the contribution of the circular economy to sustainable development, it must always be means for an end and therefore requires concrete objectives. Based on a detailed examination into the literature, the author shows that the primary goal of the circular economy should not be determined by the narrative of the dwindling resources. Rather, the goal should be the reduction of the energy expenditure of the raw material supply and the associated greenhouse gas emissions. Based on concrete empirical examples, the author shows that this conceptual orientation is absolutely necessary so that the contribution of the circular economy to climate protection and thus to sustainable development can be ensured. The author Philipp Schäfer has been working at the University of Pforzheim Resource Efficiency Management (B.Sc.) and Life Cycle and Sustainability (M.Sc.) at the University of Applied Sciences and Humanities.
content.title_en: Recycling - a means for what purpose? : Model-based determination of the energy costs of metal recycling for an empirical comparison with primary production

content.text: View, touch, understand: A knowledge story Mathematical models. About models Speech -- Models Drawing -- Models Collect -- Models Manufacture -- Models Imagery. The creation, collection and dissemination of mathematical models was widely used in universities and technical universities in the 19th and early 20th centuries.Selected models in the context of their collections show that the knowledge about mathematical models was generated in the process of modelling, collecting, selling and exhibiting. Both artistic practices and reform-pedagogical considerations were incorporated into this knowledge. The study focuses on mathematics professors who advance the use of models in the context of academic teaching in various ways. Less known is, however, that women also played an important part in the production of models. The book contributes to the analysis of numerous sources from different archives as well as an ethnographic observation of a model builder's scientific history. The author Anja Sattelmacher is a research associate at the Technical Information Library in Hanover and at the Institute of Media Studies in Berlin.
content.title_en: View, touch, grasp : A knowledge story Mathematical models

The work makes a scientific contribution to the research into the possible applications of real estate portfolio management for public museum palaces in Germany. In particular, a model for investment management specific to their organization is developed and its applicability discussed in practice with experts.
content.title_en: Real estate portfolio management of public museum palaces : data for investment management

content.text: Hope for a better past: discourses on collectivization and their codes of spatialization. Different ideas of collective identity come into conflict under the uncertain horizon of expectations of late modern societies. Jochen Kibel shows that in the dispute over the Neue Museum in Berlin and the Military History Museum in Dresden, different discourses on collectivization articulated in which the past was reshaped according to the requirements of the present. The retrospective view thus always provides the prospective hope for a better past. The dynamic conditions of the present finally produce a form of reflexive identity formation, in which the ability of persistent self-criticism is also 'found' in the past. The idea of a changeable identity then ensures a balance in the current of time, through constant course corrections.
content.title_en: Hope for a better past : collectivization discourses and their codes of spatialization

content.text: The art of bookmaking: authorship and materiality of literature between 1765 and 1815. Authorship requires more than writing a text: around 1800 it is mainly produced by the printed book. During this time it develops into a social phenomenon, in the German-speaking area the »writer's addiction« rampant. Tobias Fuchs examines in this context the practices of publishing related to the book artefact between 1765 and 1815. He considers the materiality of literature in its aesthetic, mercantile, poetic, legal and scientific dimensions. The arc ranges from Jean Paul's handwritten books to printed artifacts to maculature.
content.title_en: The Art of Bookmaking : Authorship and Materiality of Literature between 1765 and 1815

content.text: From animal data to data: a media history of electronic animal identification and data-based herd management. Digital technology has long been an integral part of mass livestock management and modern herd management. Based on electronic animal identification, »Smart Farming« operates equally with animal data and data animals. In addition to the intended identification and traceability, forms of monitoring and control are increasingly being looked at - and finally also behavioural changes in the animals themselves. From the connection of living beings and technical artifacts, questions about the status of the animal in our culture are increasingly arising. From the aspect of »anonymous individualization«, Ina Bolinski analyses the current negotiations about the changed actor status of animals, technology and humans from a media-scientific perspective.
content.title_en: From animal data to data-animals: a media history of electronic animal identification and data-based herd management

content.text: Gilles Deleuze and the Anyone Corporation : Translation processes between philosophy and architecture. The US-American discourse on architecture in the 1990s is decisively influenced by Gilles Deleuze's theories. The appropriation of his philosophical concepts and those he developed together with Félix Guattari takes place primarily within the architecture-theoretical network of the "Anyone Corporation": in its discourses, it is teeming with smooth spaces, organless bodies, rhizomes, wrinkles, abstract machines and diagrams. Frederike Lausch shows how the "Anyone Corporation" is staged by reference to Deleuze as an intellectual elite of architectural discipline and how the "post-criticality" movements emerge as part of the depoliticization of his theories.
content.title_en: Gilles Deleuze and the Anyone Corporation : Translation processes between philosophy and architecture

SixSigma4SOA is a framework for recording and evaluating quality deficits in the graphical modeling of service-oriented architectures. The framework represents an adaptation of Six Sigma into the context of graphic modelling. Here, the basic constructs of Six Sigma are maintained and extended. content.text: Whistleblowing to combat balance sheet manipulations: a play-heoric analysis of popular funding measures. Selected legal regulations and draft guidelines on whistleblowing in publicly traded companies -- Literature review – the whistleblowing intention and its promotion -- About the deterrent effect of whistleblowing – the influence of the manager-accountant interaction -- About the promotion of internal whistleblowing by the introduction of a state external channel -- whistleblowing promotion by the reduction of reporting costs. By promoting whistleblowing in the corporate environment, the aim is to detect crimes and deter potential offenders. The measures used include the establishment of internal anonymous reporting possibilities, retaliatory bans, the provision of state external channels and the possibility of monetary rewards. This book uses play-heoretic models to illustrate the strengths and weaknesses of these measures. The author Brian Halim received his doctorate at the Chair of Business Administration, insb. Corporate Accounting and Controlling of Otto-Guicke-University.
content.title_en: Whistleblowing to combat balance-sheet manipulation: a play-heoric analysis of popular support measures

content.text: New impetus for the development of digital innovations through polarity: an empirical study of the cooperation between established companies and startups against the background of increasing digitalization. Many established companies that deal with the topic of digital transformation face immense challenges in the development of digital innovations, as they are not familiar with the changing dynamics in a digital world among other things. Technology-based startups, on the other hand, usually produce digital innovations within a very short time, which can push existing products and services of established companies out of the market. The main object of this research work is the cooperation between established companies and startups in the context of the development of digital innovations. Based on the empirical studies of the five studies, it is clear that the cooperation between established companies and startups can be profitable despite different cultures in the digitalisation competition. The author Nihal Islam has studied business computer science with the specialisations IT security, project and personnel management at the Technical University of Darmstadt.
content.title_en: New impulses in the development of digital innovations through polarity: an empirical study of the cooperation between established companies and startups against the background of increasing digitalization

content.text: Marketing smarter Solutions : Customer acceptance and pricing in the business-to-business context. Introduction -- Conceptual basics and literature overview -- Customer-side acceptance of smart solutions -- Customer-side acceptance of performance-based pricing -- Final consideration. New technologies associated with the Internet of Things enable industrially-oriented companies to expand their classic product range to offer innovative services and so-called "smart solutions." Research and practice show that industrial providers are confronted with a variety of fundamental challenges when introducing smart solutions. This book contributes to a deeper understanding of the challenges to be mastered in both theoretical and practical terms, in order to successfully market smart solutions. In addition, industry-driven providers have concrete recommendations for how to successfully market smart solutions and establish a viable business model. Author Dr. Eva Kropp has been awarded a PhD at Prof. Dr. Dirk Totzek at the Chair of Marketing and Services at Passau University. Currently she is a research assistant.
content.title_en: Marketing of smart solutions : Customer acceptance and pricing in the business-to-business context

content.text: The aestheticization and politicization of death : mobile videos of violence and death in the Syrian conflict. Since its beginnings, we have encountered the Syrian conflict mainly in videos that were first recorded with smartphones, later also with high-resolution action cameras. These videos are widely used over the Internet by international coverage, but also by artists and film makers. Mareike Meis develops in this context a research perspective that in an innovative way opens up videos of violence and death for scientific access and thereby makes related activist, jihadist and right-wing populist practices in the field of tension between aestheticization and politicization crititic.
content.title_en: The Aestheticization and Politicization of Death : Mobile Videos of Violence and Death in the Syrian Conflict

content.text: Fatigue of the tension-stiffening effect in reinforced concrete. The composite between reinforcement and concrete determines the load and deformation behaviour of reinforced concrete structures. Using experiments, the fatigue of the composite and the involvement of the concrete between the cracks is investigated. Calculation models are proposed to determine the mechanical behaviour of tensile belts and the inclination of pressure struts in reinforced concrete beams under fatigue stress. The bond between reinforcement and concrete determinations the carrying and deformation capacity of concrete structures. Based on performed tests, the fatigue of bond and the subsequent degradation of the tension-stiffening effect are invested. As a result, calculation models are proposed in order to determine the mechanical behavior of tension chords and the inclusion of forces affecting effects.
content.title_en: Fatigue of the tension-stiffening effect in reinforced concrete

content.text: Climate justice and climate policy: the negotiating positions of the USA, China and India from 2009-2018. What are the meanings of different equity considerations for the emission reduction policies of the three major issuer states USA, China and India? And how do these shape the development of the international climate regime? Based on an independently developed analysis grid, the discursanalytic study as one of the first works examines the international and national negotiating positions along different justice dimensions. The study reveals that the convergence of climate justice positions by approaching in 2015 first became greater before it became much smaller again in 2018. What are the implications of different perceptions of the international climate regime? Based on an independently developed analyze analysis framework, this is the expatriate-driven-complicate.
content.title_en: Climate justice and climate policy: the negotiating positions of the US, China and India 2009-2018

content.text: Autonomous and networked actors in civil law: basic lines of civil law assignment and structural characteristics of an electronic person. Private law is confronted with a technology that is characterised by an hitherto unknown autonomous decision-making power. With the traditional accounting standards, the behaviour of these systems is difficult to assign to a legal entity. Network technologies such as blockchain also justify new units that are unable to capture civil and corporate law. Are these developments an occasion to attribute a legal status to a technical system? Can responsibility deficits be reduced by a channel of liability to an ePerson? And how would such a legal entity be structured to integrate into legal transactions? Dimitrios Linardatos develops interdisciplinary application-oriented solutions and concrete legislative proposals that counteract a responsibility diffusion?
content.title_en: Autonomous and networked agents in civil law : basic lines of civil law assignment and structural characteristics of an electronic person

content.text: The debt of minors is not only of interest from a social and economic perspective. Rather, this phenomenon also poses considerable problems to legal science and practice. The progressive digitalization of everyday life has increased the legal and delict liability risks of minors. Cyril Hergenröder first examines the protection mechanisms existing in favour of underage debtors by means of practical case-making. In this analysis, besides the material civil law, procedural aspects of the civil procedural order and the insolvency order are also included. The author examines the existing legal situation and then examines the potential for reform, which exists in relation to the protection gaps that have emerged during the investigation. Cyril Hergenröder applies valid cases to examine existence prevention measures and attitude, and attitude of behavioural and financial overburden.
content.title_en: Minority and financial overburden

content.text: The European passport for banking transactions. The European passport for banking transactions is a central instrument of European regulation of cross-border banking activities. Its practical importance has been brought to the fore in the public, especially as a result of the "Brexit". Although the European passport was already introduced in Germany by the 4th KWG-Novelle of 21 December 1992, its dogmatic classification and the corresponding display procedure have remained largely unexplained. Against this background, Heinrich Nemeczek examines the dogmatic structure of the European passport for banking transactions in Germany, taking into account the single supervisory mechanism (Single Supervisory Mechanism) and regulatory insufficiencys resulting from the provision of cross-border banking transactions. Heinrich Nemeczek examines the doctrinal structure of the European passport for banking business in Germany. In particular, his analysis addresses the Single Supervisory Mechanism and regulatory law which may apply in the market with cross-border service.
content.title_en: The European passport for banking

content.text: Antisense regulation of gene expression of Streptococcus pyogenes in virulence and therapy. Streptococcus pyogenes is a strictly human pathogenic bacterium that is a high burden on human health and health systems worldwide. In this work the focus was on the investigation of the antisense regulation of gene expression. On the one hand, small regulatory RNAs were identified and their significance for gene regulation in S. pyogenes was investigated in two examples. On the other hand, an antisense-based therapy approach with carrierpeptide-coupled peptide nucleic acids for S. pyogenes was established.
content.title_en: Antisense regulation of gene expression of Streptococcus pyogenes in virulence and therapy

content.text: Artificial neural networks as an instrument of value driver analysis in the context of value-oriented corporate management using the example of the EVA. 1 Introduction -- 2 Value-oriented corporate management -- 3 Artificial neural networks -- 4 Value driver analysis model -- 5 Final consideration. In this book, an instrument that can be integrated into current planning instruments to improve the decision-making support function of controlling with the possibility of focusing on decision-makers is developed. The focus is on the technical feasibility of an analysis of value drivers using artificial neural networks in the context of value orientation. The author Marius Hölscher is a full-time lecturer at the University of Public Administration and Police (HSPV) NRW and at the University of Bielefeld as a scientific assistant in economic science fields with a focus on accounting, controlling and management.

content.text: The construction-operational optimization of the full-walled concrete 3D printing process. Concrete 3D printing processes will enable the construction processes to be realized more plannable, productive and sustainable. Due to the highly demanding boundary conditions on construction sites and the unique construction methods typical in the construction sector, concrete 3D printing processes will be subject to special challenges. The innovative technologies are also in economic competition with conventional construction processes. In order to ensure the economic efficiency and process reliability of concrete 3D printing processes, the 3D printing strategy and decisive process parameters are to be optimised under the focus of the construction-operational. This book includes a scientific study on the structural optimization of the full-walled concrete 3D printing process. In particular, three main areas are examined. The first focus is on the process-specific boundary conditions. The author is a scientific employee at the Institute for Construction-operational Engineering of the TUD in 2014 and the construction-operational engineering of the concrete process.
content.title_en: Optimization of full-wall concrete 3D printing

content.text: Characterization of in-stational flow situations and analysis of their influence on vehicle aerodynamics. Christoph Jessing provides detailed insights into the real in-stationary flow of a vehicle in representative driving situations. The effects on the air resistance coefficient resulting from the identified in-stational flow situations are presented in the scale 1:4 and 1:1 in the wind tunnel experiment as well as in the numerical flow simulation. In addition to the influence of in-stational flow on air resistance, the effect of aerodynamic components under instationary flow is also illustrated. The author thus makes an important contribution to the understanding of in-stational vehicle aerodynamics and describes how the development tools currently used in the vehicle industry can achieve a better predictive quality of air resistance in realistic flow. The content of in-stationary vehicle aerodynamics: state of technology and development tools Characterization of in-stational flow situations Simulation of in-stationary flow technology in the experimental and numerical investigation environments of the vehicle.
content.title_en: Characterization of instationary flow situations and analysis of their influence on vehicle aerodynamics

content.text: Digitalization of operational controlling processes: Definition, application cases and success assessment. Hardly any other term is currently of such high importance in politics, business and science as digitalisation. Digitalization shows far-reaching, partly disruptive effects on the whole business models, organizational structures or processes of companies, including controlling processes. This volume examines the previously insufficiently answered question, which fields of application and success potentials the use of digital technologies in operational controlling processes offers. The empirical results of the work with 120 participating companies contribute to an extension of the evidence-based knowledge base in this topic area and in particular to the derivation of practical recommendations for the introduction and use of digital technologies in operational controlling processes. Hasan Andaç Güler is Head of Global Controlling Standards at Schenck Process and has been involved in his professional dissertation on the topic of digitalization in operational controlling. In addition, Hasan Andaç Güler is a lecturer at the University of Applied Sciences in the context of Financial Management. As a business consultant at Horth-Diversity-Diversity-Diversity, he has advised in the field of business management and business management.
content.title_en: Digitization of operational controlling processes : definition, use cases and success assessment

content.text: The process-oriented topology optimization for additive manufacturing. Topology optimizations enable the functional design of high-performance components, but mostly result in complex component geometries. Additive manufacturing is particularly suitable for the production of such components due to the possible great freedom of design. However, the process-related restrictions of additive manufacturing are to be considered in order to ensure the productionability of the components. Direct integration of restrictions into topology optimizations increases the cost-effectiveness of the construction. In the work, new methods for the closure of materials, the avoidance of closed cavities and the avoidance of non-self-supporting channels were investigated. The content - Opens new possibilities for the construction of AM components - Shows new approaches for the integration of restrictions in topology optimizations - Allows an acceleration of the design process The author Fritz Lange studied physics engineering with a focus on numerics and simulation at the Technical University of Berlin. content.text: The contemporary art has been characterised by its temporality and its historicality. Film, slide and video installations have shaped contemporary art since the 1990s. One of its most striking features is the work with the various temporal levels of the moving image. In the works of artists such as Tacita Dean, Douglas Gordon, Mark Lewis and James Coleman, temporality and historicality play a decisive role. Time as a pictorial phenomenon is seen and experienced through aesthetic practices. Through visual strategies such as the manipulation of the duration of images, their movements, rhythms and dynamics, the works simultaneously realize a specific historicality. This creates hybrid works of art between standstill and movement, between present and history. The volume offers detailed analyses and interpretations of numerous key works of the past 25 years.
content.title_en: Timeliness and historicality of the moving image in contemporary art

content.text: Involvement as a transformation?! : an empirical analysis of the recontextualization strategies of school leaders in the context of school inclusion. The task to design school inclusion raises questions about a transformation of the existing school and education system. The school leaders take a central role here as actors to "translate" this task into practice (recontextualize) in order to initiate and shape corresponding changes in their schools. In this context, they are confronted with complex contradictions and problems within the segregative German school system. Against this background, the work analyses and reconstructs the different strategies of school leaders for designing school inclusion in the individual schools on the basis of comprehensive quantitative and qualitative empirical data. As a central result, four implementation scenarios are systematized, in which despite fundamentally limited transformation possibilities on the part of school-conducting action and interpretation spaces become clear, the demand for inclusion through a potentially system-changing management trade and also to subvert the inclusion of the empirical findings as a basis for the school's empirical implementation.
content.title_en: Inclusion as Transformation?! : an empirical analysis of the recontextualization strategies of school leaders in the context of school inclusion

content.text: Characterization of the temperature-dependent fatigue and damage behaviour of glass fibre reinforced polyurethane and epoxy in the LCF to VHCF range. Daniel Hülsbusch performs a characterization of the fatigue and damage behaviour of a newly developed glass fibre reinforced polyurethane ggü. of a glass fiber reinforced epoxy under operationally relevant ambient temperatures of -30 to +70 °C. In the course of this high frequency testing methods are developed with special consideration of the self-heating for the use on glass fiber reinforced plastics, in order to determine the material properties up to the VHCF range by alternating cyclical stress and in situ computer tomographic defect analyses. The results serve to understand the material and environment-dependent training of fatigue properties – in particular by a differentiated description of the damage development in the HCF and VHCF range – and the continuous residual life estimation. The results serve as an understanding of the material and environment-dependent structure-based training of the fatigue properties of the university's scientific field of expertise.
content.title_en: Characterization of temperature-dependent fatigue and damage behaviour of glass fibre reinforced polyurethane and epoxy in the LCF to VHCF range

content.text: Application of molecular biological stem comparison techniques in clinical mastitis epidemiology. Molecular biological stem comparison methods are not yet part of the routine diagnosis of mastitis secretions in Germany. These methods were used to understand the distribution routes of microorganisms within a herd, to make the distinction between contagious and non-contagious infections and to determine the proportion of persistent infections under recurrent infections. The results show that stem comparison techniques have the potential to contribute significantly to the solution in case of individual mastitis problems.
content.title_en: Application of molecular biological stem comparison techniques in clinical mastitis epidemiology

content.text: Negational congruence in German dialects. A striking feature in the German basic dialects is the so-called "negational congruence" or "double negation". It is all the more surprising that up to now only selectively researched into individual dialects has been carried out, but there is no microtypologically based corpus-based work on this phenomenon. Ann-Marie Moser concludes this research gap: she identifies two different types of negation congruence and explains that these negational constructions are distributed differently in space. The negational congruence is not obligatory, but optional – while approaches from minimalism can only deal with optionality in a limited way, an analysis within the scope of the optimality theory is offered. A qualitatively based data collection in the upper German space confirms that speakers of the Alemannian and Bairian differ in the choice of negational construction and on a pragmatic level. Finally, Moser looks at the question why the negation congruence is not possible in the standard German, but in all German dialects.
content.title_en: Negational congruence in the German dialects

content.text: Revolution and broken transformation in Egypt: secular parties and social movements in the »Arab Spring«. »The people want the fall of the regime!« The call of the people of Egypt for freedom and self-determination, which echoed through the streets of Cairo in 2011, remains unforgettable. In a theoretically innovative and interdisciplinary way, Imad Mustafa combines structural, network-theoretical, constructive and communicative aspects of the transition process to comprehensively investigate the revolutionary mobilization of secular networks as well as the conflicting confrontations with the regime and the Muslim Brotherhood. Thus, he shows that democratization is a contradictory and difficult process, at the end of which the re-authorization of politics can stand.
content.title_en: Revolution and broken transformation in Egypt : secular parties and social movements in the »Arab Spring«

content.text: The crisis of confidence has a short-term effect: whether politics, science or journalism - no social subsystem is spared any public suspicions of distrust. But what exactly does the dazzling term "system confidence" mean and what consequences does a lack of it have? G. Schmidt follows these questions from a socio-theoretical perspective. He shows the social integral meaning of journalism and examines to what extent it can fulfil its role as a trust mediator in neoliberal capitalism. An economized journalism - his thesis - causes social integration disorders, which then fall back on it in the form of authoritarianism.
content.title_en: System Confidence and Journalism in Neoliberalism

content.text: Mentoring processes in teachers:in-school training : successful conditions for school internships. The present work deals with mentoring in teachers:in-school training as a cooperative and experience-based learning form within the framework of school practice. Mentoring:in-school students are available as a support and advisory between basic high-school and schulpractical training elements in the field of vocational training. In the volume fundamental aspects of mentoring are presented in the context of teaching and systematically worked out. Based on this, results of a reconstruction study on successful conditions of schulpractic mentoring processes from the teaching and student perspective are presented. Theoretical considerations and empirical findings are integrated into a practice-related model on successful conditions. The work thus aims to contribute to the current discussion about mentoring in teachers:in-school education and its further development.
content.title_en: Mentoring processes in teachers: In-school training : successful conditions for school internships

content.text: Family care as a health risk: the role of the household, migration and country context. The care of dependent relatives is one of the most important tasks of our time. It is unclear whether this entails health deterioration for informal caregivers. This work investigates the question whether informal care is associated with negative health consequences by using European longitudinal data (Survey of Health, Ageing and Retirement in Europe and English Longitudinal Study of Ageing). It is taken into account that possible health consequences may vary depending on the location (within or outside the home) and country of care acceptance as well as the origin of the caregivers. As a result, care constellations show that there is a great (emotional/spatial) proximity between caregivers and grooms and in countries with low formal care provision. No differences in the health consequences of informal care are shown by the relationship between the origin context, i.e. migration background. The results make social action requirements for the caregivers and show that the university's welfare system is a quantitatively-related issue.
content.title_en: Family care as a health risk : the role of the domestic, migration and country context

content.text: The construction of entrepreneurial futures: a study on communication and legitimacy of future ideas. How and why do companies communicate about the future of humanity? In this work, the future stories of Facebook and SpaceX are empirically reconstructed. The focus of the study is on the public communication of prominent entrepreneurs Mark Zuckerberg and Elon Musk. Using these paradigmatic actors, it is shown which ways entrepreneurial visions of the future explicitly enroll in the knowledge of the future of the present. A critical view sheds light on the origins of these visions and reveals how entrepreneurial prophecy narrows the potential space of the future in a specific way. The author Joachim Haupt works as a consultant, lecturer and researcher on topics of strategic organizational communication. He received his doctorate at the University of the Arts Berlin. .
content.title_en: The construction of entrepreneurial futures: a study on communication and legitimacy of future ideas

content.text: Determination of structural reactivity relationships in CeO2-based catalysts for the Selective Catalytic Low Temperature NH3 Reduction of NOx : Influence of trivalent doping sessions on the reactivity of ceroxides. The present dissertation deals with the influence of trivalent doping elements on the catalytic activity of ceroxides in the NH3-SCR of NOx with and without V-impregnating. As doping elements Fe3+, Y3+, Co3+, Sb3+ and Bi3+ were chosen in different concentrations. The resulting mixed oxides and solid solutions of the type Ce(1-x)MxO(2-d) were subjected to catalytic testing and extensively characterized. To understand the structure of the catalysts under reaction conditions, operando DRIFTS, EPR and in situ XANES were applied.
content.title_en: Determination of structural reactivity relationships in CeO2-based catalysts for the Selective Catalytic Low Temperature NH3 Reduction of NOx : Influence of trivalent doping sessions on the reactivity of ceroxides

content.text: Differentiation experiences and their artistic expression in collages : Using Hannah Höch's example. What can be understood (everything) as collage? An adhesive paper image? An artistic expression? A research method? Theories of inclusion? An art pedagogical attitude? An (artist:Innen-)biography? This book? Within the present work, the (art) history of collage is critically examined; moreover, collage is theorized as an artistic, methodological, epistemological and biographical principle and is connected with questions of difference and experience. Starting from the theoretical subjectivation, the empirical part – by means of image and discursanalytic methods – examines biography and life (work) of the Berlin Dada artist Hannah Höch (1889-1978) in relation to possible difference experiences. Thus, this book is based on a post-structural search for traces to ask: How do we show, concreteize, see, materialize differential experiences? Which (intersectional) differences can be identified in collage works?
content.title_en: Differentiation experiences and their artistic expression in collages : Hannah Höchs example

content.text: In this book, Annika Breternitz examines the views of teachers on school errors and the factors that influence them. The views of mistakes as a learning opportunity and a failure to sanction them have their legitimacy in the context of school. In today's professional discussion, the relevance of the constructive approach of teachers to school errors is repeatedly highlighted. The author examines with a view to the (general) ambivalence of the evaluation of errors, which views teachers become recognizable and which factors influence them (such as school form, task of teachers, training). Here, the focus is on a transnational approach that takes into account the Finnish and German education systems. The author Annika Breternitz has worked at the University of Paderborn at the Institute of Education in the field of school education. Her research focuses on the field of international comparative empirical qualitative error research.
content.title_en: View of teachers on school errors: a transnational qualitative study in Finland and North Rhine-Westphalia

content.text: "Like=Remember--: Online Remembrance Cultures to the Shoah: (Re-)Configurations of Memory and Forgetting through Media Practices. Klappentext: This volume systematically and theoretically guides the everyday, social transfer of knowledge about the Shoah through digital practices. These are the basis for an innovative analysis model of online memory cultures that is developed along popular and media artistic examples. In this context, questions about normative negotiations, forms of witnessing as well as transnational digital action routines are regrouped from a media-scientific perspective under the concept of (re-)configurations. Mathias Scheicher is a member of the Faculty of Philosophy at Siegen University. He studied media science, political science and sociology and taught teaching at the University of Siegen and Humboldt University of Berlin in the field of digital cultures.
content.title_en: "Like=Remember: Online memory cultures of the Shoah: (re-)configurations of memory and forgetfulness through media practices

content.text: The limits of the freedom of testing: an investigation of the limitations of the individual-protecting freedom by law, jurisprudence and literature. The freedom of testing is generally characterized as the most individual and in its exercise the least Community-bound right protected by the Constitution. Nevertheless, the freedom of testing is subject to numerous limitations. The determination of the scope of such limits can be a danger to the individual-protecting character of the freedom of testing. Noel Schröder undertakes a systematic and comprehensive analysis of the restrictions of the central freedom of the deceased. He examines the places where the freedom of testing is exposed to inadmissible impairments, and thereby refutes a number of basic assumptions, often used to limit the fundamentally guaranteed power of action of the deceased. Noel Schröder studies freedom of testing and refugees a number of dogmatic hypotheses in case law and jurisprudence which are used to limit freedom of the station.
content.title_en: The Limits of Testing Freedom: an Investigation of the Limitations of Individual Protecting Freedom by Law, Law and Literature

content.text: Transnational climate and energy governance: the European Union and North America compared. Combating climate change and ensuring sustainable, reliable and economic energy supply are increasingly seen as the central human task of the 21st century. Political problem handling does not end at national borders, but always has a transnational component in view of diverse interdependencies. The functional logic and performance of such transnational governance processes differ from region to region: while the states of the European Union can use the comprehensive and legal architecture of the EU system for this purpose, such an institutional structure is missing in other parts of the world. This book analyses the policies on climate protection and renewable energies as well as market regulation in the electricity and natural gas sector in Europe and North America and examines the question of how the differences between the two systems affect the performance of governance. The author Simon Haas is a political scientist and political journalist. He holds a doctorate from Professor Dr. Martin Sebaldt at the University of Regensburg. His research focuses are the energy and climate protection policy as well as the system of the European Union. Currently he is First Mayor of the municipality of Haselbach in Lower Bavaria.
content.title_en: Transnational climate and energy governance: compared with the European Union and North America

content.text: The Scrum Framework in Large Companies - Decision and Implementation : a case study of a multinational automotive group. This book shows how managers can optimally implement the Scrum Framework in large companies. It demonstrates on the one hand how heuristics/simple rules management decisions guide the introduction of the Scrum Framework, on the other hand how essential it is to unlearn (intendional forgetfulness) of rules to adapt the Scrum Framework in large organizations. Marcel F. Volland formulates his findings on the basis of a broad case study of a multinational automobile manufacturer. The special feature of this case is that the middle management has particularly driven the spread of the agile Framework Scrum in the company. Author Marcel F. Volland has carried out a case study on the introduction of the Scrum Framework in a multinational automobile company in the context of his doctorate at the Chair of Organization and Corporate Management (Prof. Dr. Jetta Frost) of the University of Hamburg.
content.title_en: Scrum framework in large companies - Decision and implementation : a case study of a multinational automobile company

In order to monitor their development over time, surface monitoring is necessary. The potential of multisensoral drone data is investigated to derive vegetation compositions and plant parameters with machine learning. One of the central findings of the work is that a fusion of digital surface model, texture and infrared light allows a valuable contribution to the monitoring of these partially difficult-to-access and climate-relevant ecosystems.
content.title_en: Analysis of vegetation and the derivation of plant parameters in wetlands from multisensoral remote sensing data of unmanned flight systems

In theoretical discussions it is often overlooked that the human-object relations designed by design are incorporated into deeper systemic contexts and that design as a discipline represents a specific reaction to the contingency problems of modern society. content.text: The present work is aimed at engineers and scientists of technical building equipment. It addresses a emerging need for changes in the environmental and sustainability assessment of buildings and thermal installations. The currently used non-renewable primary energy demand will not be sufficient, especially in terms of future political climate and environmental protection goals as the sole assessment size. The eco-efficiency evaluation method presented with this work can contribute as an appropriate tool to solving the problems. It enables systematic, holistic assessments and reproducible comparisons of thermal installations with regard to their ecological and economic sustainability. The most important new developments are the specific environmental performance, in addition to the primary energy factor used, and the eco-efficiency indicator UWI.
content.title_en: Method for eco-efficiency assessment of thermal installations in buildings

content.text: The desire for diversity: diversity sensitivity in social-pedagogical relationships. Why do specialists in child and youth support passionately identify with the ideal of diversity? And what promises are contained in the professional ideal of diversity-reflective relationships? Marie Frühauf's feminist-lacanian study looks at the desire that specialists attach to diversity. The associated design of the educational relationship is interpreted against the background of a post-edipal and at the same time gender-specific social constellation in which the other seems paradoxically to lose importance within the pedagogical relationship.
content.title_en: The desire for diversity: diversity sensitivity in social-educational relations

content.text: Gilles Deleuze and the Anyone Corporation : Translation processes between philosophy and architecture. The US-American discourse on architecture in the 1990s is decisively influenced by Gilles Deleuze's theories. The appropriation of his philosophical concepts and those he developed together with Félix Guattari takes place primarily within the architecture-theoretical network of the "Anyone Corporation": in its discourses, it is teeming with smooth spaces, organless bodies, rhizomes, wrinkles, abstract machines and diagrams. Frederike Lausch shows how the "Anyone Corporation" is staged by reference to Deleuze as an intellectual elite of architectural discipline and how, as part of the depoliticization of his theories, the "post-criticality" movements emerge.
content.title_en: Gilles Deleuze and the Anyone Corporation : Translation processes between philosophy and architecture

content.text: Acquiescence in a historical exhibition: an inventory of elements of historical thinking among visitors to the exhibition "14/18. Switzerland and the Great War". What do museum applicants think when visiting a historical exhibition and what references do they make to their own person and present? Using process-accompanying sounds of thinking during the exhibition visit, the approaches of 18 adult visitors to the exhibition "14/18. Switzerland and the Great War" were observed and systematized and structured using content-structuring qualitative content analysis. The historical didactic study thus illuminates the ways adults interact with a historical cultural manifestation and offers insights into the interplay of exhibition, storytelling history and individual perspectives of visitors.
content.title_en: Acquisition in a historical exhibition: an inventory of elements of historical thinking by visitors to the exhibition «14/18. Switzerland and the Great War»

content.text: Nonlinear education in sports and mathematics. Nonlinear education (NLP) approaches the learning of pupils as reflexive education via explicit naming of their own basic assumptions. Here, a learner is modelled as a dynamic system, from whose characteristics, such as the formation of attractors, phase transitions, openness to the environment or ability to self-organize, derivations to learning, which represent the basic principles of the NLP. While the research activities of the NLP so far aimed primarily at coordinative, tactical or motivational improvement in sports, volume 14 of the series of school sport research provides the transfer of the NLP into sports and mathematics teaching and observes the fundamental fit of the principles as well as the effects of an application on learning process and results of students. For this purpose, coaching of three teachers has initiated instruction interventions in three mathematics and sports classes each and accompanies the implementation of interviews, observations, questionnaires and grades. As a result, the principles of the NLP are largely also characterized by an exmotivation of the school and mathematics teaching.
content.title_en: Nonlinear education in sports and mathematics

content.text: Computer use in school and school lab : Attitude of physics teachers to new media. The attitude of teachers determines their actions. The present study deals with the usage behaviour and the attitude of physics teachers to computers and new media in the educational context. Furthermore, the attitude and assessment of students on this topic is examined. Methodically, quantitative analysis methods were used and combined on the basis of questionnaires, as well as qualitative methods such as semi-open interviews. Through the exploratory study it was possible to determine that the attitude to computer use in physics teaching can be described in six dimensions, on the basis of which teachers are classified into five groups: Prevented users, curious people, computer enthusiasts, realists and avoidrs. For each of these groups different recommendations can be formulated in order to promote the use of new media in physics teachers.
content.title_en: Computer use in school and school laboratory : Attitude of physics teachers to new media

content.text: "Heroes and thinkers" of pedagogy in the mirror of their specialist lexica from 1774 to 1945. Who are the heroes and thinkers in pedagogy and educational science, who their heroines and thinkers? Which persons are presented in the reference works of discipline – in their knowledge stores – with their own lemma? What economic cycles and canonization processes can be observed? The present work examines the person lemmmato in all 29 German-language, alphabetically sorted, general pedagogical specialist lexica until the middle of the 20th century. In a quantitative part, she systematically analyzes the lemmato and its person lemmato by various categories. In a qualitative part, four persons – Johann Heinrich Pestalozzi, Friedrich Daniel Ernst Schleiermacher, Wilhelm Rein and Helene Lange – as well as the group of the first women mentioned in Lexika, are analyzed in depth with regard to change and continuity in lexicographic reception and representation.
content.title_en: "Heroes and thinkers" of pedagogy in the mirror of their specialist lexica from 1774 to 1945

content.text: Digital editions in the field of tension between media change: analyses and solution strategies from the point of view of computer science. In the field of tension between the media change from printed to digital edition, complex and often conflicting forces work. From the perspective of computer science, Andreas Oberhoff identifies the origins and interactions of these forces, specifies them as essential conflicts and analyzes them systematizingly by adapting established concepts. Based on these theoretical findings, he derives technical requirements for modern edition infrastructures, develops innovative conflict resolution strategies (including with the help of blockchain technologies) and provides a methodology for the evaluation of this balancing technology use based on audit reliability for the first time.
content.title_en: Digital Editions in the Interruption of Media Change : Analysis and Solution Strategies from the Perspective of Computer Science

content.text: Evaluation of solar joints on aluminium surfaces for the interconnection of silicon solar cells. In the context of this thesis, the direct solderability of aluminium, with the aim of application in the photovoltaic industry, is investigated. The natural Al2O3 oxide layer makes it difficult to solder aluminium components. Nevertheless, it is possible to develop strong solder joints using a suitable surface coating. The soldering sites, their relevant properties, as well as those of the coatings, are evaluated in the present work. In this thesis, direct soldering of aluminium is investigated, with a special focus on application in the photovoltaic industry. The native Al2O3 layer impedes the solidarity of Al components. However, strong soldiers joins are formed when suitable surfaces are used. The native Al2O3 layer impedes the solidarity of Al components.
content.title_en: Evaluation of solar joints on aluminium surfaces for the connection of silicon solar cells

content.text: Methods for increasing formaldehyde productivity and selectivity in methane oxidation via silica-carried VOx catalysts. In this work, the possibility of increasing formaldehyde productivity of VOx/SiO2 catalysts in the selective oxidation of methane through synthesis optimization, water addition and modelling was investigated.
content.title_en: Methods for increasing formaldehyde productivity and selectivity in methane oxidation via silica-carried VOx catalysts

content.text: Business model innovation in portfolio companies in the hands of private equity companies. Introduction -- Fundamentals of the private equity market -- Business model and business model innovation -- Empirical investigation -- Final review -- Bibliography. About this book The author analyses the extent to which private equity companies use the method of business model innovation as a value-added approach in their portfolio companies. Based on a multiple case study, the author examines what on the one hand private equity companies qualify for, on the other hand, private equity companies, which are the prerequisites for business model innovation and why private equity companies are suitable partners in the implementation of this concept. The author Carl-Philipp Barth received his doctorate at the Chair of ABWL, Organisation and Personnel (Prof. Dr. Max Ringlstetter) of the Catholic University of Eichstätt-Ingolstadt. Currently, he is working as a consultant in the Financial Advisory.
content.title_en: Business model innovation in portfolio companies in the hands of private equity companies

content.text: Epistemical images: for the media onto epistemology of visualisation. If something becomes visible in scientific contexts, then often because it has been made visible in experimental processes. The operative »distinctization« allows new perspectives on the disjunctive interlinkage of scientific and media history. An archaeology of the visible - as it can be understood, for example, by the example of microphotographic processes of bacteriology - emphasizes the material-discursive configuration of knowledge production. The generated »epistemic images« thus function as relays between knowledge and visibility. Sebastian Scholz approaches this complex constellation with the aim of problematizing »the visible« and to show potentials of an operative media onto epistemology.
content.title_en: Epistemical images : on the medial onto epistemology of visualisation

content.text: The Profit Split Method for determining transfer prices: An analysis of the existing transfer pricing rules. In this book Selina Reif analyses the rules for the application of profit splits as a transfer pricing method. According to a description of the relevant rules and their content, the German regulations, the principles of the OECD transfer pricing policy according to BEPS and their interaction are subject to evaluation. Main focus is on the design and applicability in specific cases. For the resulting weaknesses the author develops possible improvement proposals. The author Selina Reif received her doctorate from the Faculty of Law of the Ludwig Maximilian University of Munich and during this time worked as a scientific assistant at the Max Planck Institute for Tax Law and Public Finance, Department of Corporate and Tax Law in Munich. The author has started her studies of law at the Ludwig-Maximilians-Universität München with the completion of the first state examination. After completing her doctorate and the second legal state examination at the OLG Munich, the author works as a lawyer in a large commercial law firm in tax law.
content.title_en: The profit split method for determining transfer prices : An analysis of the existing transfer pricing rules

content.text: Research on the sound generation of a motor vehicle cooling fan in installation situation. Maren Gollub uses experimental and numerical methods to investigate the sound generation of a motor vehicle cooling fan in the installation situation. She presents a test bench with which the influence of the individual components in the impeller flow on the tonal noise is determined. By means of an accompanying flow simulation, the author identifies imbalances in the impeller flow, which are linked to the previously examined components. Based on the findings gained from these two steps, she develops demonstrators that significantly reduce the tonal noise of the fan.The content of the automotive cooling fan – state of the art Description and validation of the test stand and the simulation model Investigation of the tonal sound formation The target groups Dozierende and students in the fields of aero-, fan and vehicle acoustics Research and development engineers in the automotive and supplier industry are now working at the Institute for Vehicle Engineering and Technology in Stuttgart.
content.title_en: Study of the sound formation of a car cooler fan in installation situation

content.text: Physical Dissatisfaction with Girls in Adolescence: A Mixed Methodist Intervention Study in Sports Education. Introduction -- Theoretical Background -- Research Status - Synthesis of Theory and Research and Conclusions -- Aims and Research Questions of the Study -- Development of Sports Education Intervention -- Methodical Procedure -- Presentation of Results -- Summary Discussion of Findings -- Conclusion and Outlook. Girls in Adolescence are often affected by body dissatisfaction associated with health risks such as diet and (sub)clinical eating disorders. Since sports activity is a factor that can reduce body dissatisfaction and support a positive body image, the present study examines whether the body dissatisfaction of girls in adolescence can be reduced by a specific sport instruction intervention. Moreover, in a qualitative partial examination, girls with a high body dissatisfaction and their subjective view on the subject area of their research are concentrated in the field of sports science.
content.title_en: Body dissatisfaction with girls in adolescence : A mixed-methods intervention study in sports lessons

content.text: Product-based evaluation of customer relationships in plant engineering. For a goal-oriented design of business relationships, in-depth customer information is required. To this end, a valuation methodology is to be proposed, which provides fundamentally decision-based correct customer information. Marcel Röser designs in this volume a valuation methodology for customer relationships in machine and plant engineering, which is based on a product-based life cycle calculation and which is successively further supplemented and refined. In addition to the product-related after-run effects, which are already recorded in a life cycle calculation, further influence factors occur, including the subsequent projects of the considered customer, the cross-selling potential, the customer-related reference potential, and customer loyalty. This requires more than other cost-related tasks, at the same time an adequate risk consideration and the integration of risk bias in the evaluation of decision proposals. The solution approach to the simultaneous calculation of customer risk profiles enables the customer to contribute to the business relationship.
content.title_en: Product-based evaluation of customer relationships in machine and plant engineering

content.text: It is a question of how to deal with the heterogeneity in the classroom. How can one cope with the loss of social significance of the Christian faith and religion as a whole? Karoline Pohl-Otto is dedicated to these questions in a study on a popular cultural mass medium – the comic. The author brings together existing research results and new analyses and theories based on an interdisciplinary and multi-perspective approach to explore the extent to which the work with comics is beneficial for learning processes. She examines how the medium can be used to improve the quality of teaching and to address learners in their diversity – both in religious instruction and in other school subjects.

content.text: In his work, Michael Brotz examines the potential of variable valve drive for NOx storage catalyst regeneration in diesel engines in lower partial load mode. He demonstrates the influence of high internal residual gas rates on the under-stichiometric combustion process through extensive thermodynamic analyses. The experiments are carried out experimentally on the engine test bench on a four-cylinder diesel engine with variable valve drive. Using the developed methodology and variable valve drive, the author succeeds in extending the permissible field of characteristic of NOx storage catalyst regeneration to lower engine loads. The content Basic analysis for lowering the fresh air mass by means of variable valve drive Analysis of the under-stochiometric diesel combustion process Potential estimation of high internal residual gas rates for NSK regeneration The target groups Dozierde and students of automotive technology Development engineers in the field of thermodynamics and combustion process development, especially in the field of NOx storage catalyst The author Michael Brotz has been a PhD in the field of thermodynamics at the University of Stuttgart.
content.title_en: NOx storage catalyst regeneration for variable valve drive diesel engines

content.text: Photo-mediated oxygen atom transfer and light-induced organocatalytic and transition metal-catalyzed amination reactions. The work describes the deoxygenation of various pyrimidopteridine-N-oxidide derivatives, their photophysical investigations and their different application and mechanistic investigations of metal-free hydroamination. In addition, photophysical and electrochemical properties of pyridine-N-oxidide derivatives are investigated as oxygen transfer reagents and the conversion into (methylsulfonyloxy)pyridineium methan sulfonate is described. Finally, a palladium-catalysed C-N bond formation between dimethylamines and aryltriflatene is discussed.
content.title_en: Photo-mediated oxygen atom transfer and light-induced organocatalytic and transition metal-catalyzed amination reactions

content.text: Data protection and antitrust law. Digital platforms have experienced a rapid rise in the number of years and are facing entirely new challenges in the field of privacy and privacy. In particular, the issue of data protection law, which must respond to new possibilities for data processing, and antitrust law, which is facing new forms of anti-competitive action, is the focus of the discussion. This raises the question of synergies between the two areas. -- The discussion focuses on the German Federal Cartel Office's Facebook process, which concludes that the violation of data protection law can also be pursued by means of antitrust law. The subsequent judicial proceedings, including the BGH, have raised further questions about the interaction of the two areas. With the Facebook process as the starting point of the investigation, Fabian Uebele is investigating the overlap between antitrust law and data protection. The focus is also on the regulation of online platforms. / »Data Protection and Competition Law« by the book explores the overlaps between antitrust law and data protection concerns.
content.title_en: Data protection and antitrust law
